However, events that are marked for expiration can be retained to allow processing based on a checkpoint, e.g., expiration of the event can be refused until there is an assurance the event was read by the processing application.
problem: Managing expiration of events in an ordered event stream while ensuring processing applications have read the events before deletion.
constraint: Tradeoff between retaining events for processing completeness and freeing storage space, requiring dynamic adjustment based on real-time processing status.
mechanism: Progress indicators from processing applications are used to determine a safe deletion point in an ordered event sequence. Events before the deletion point are marked for removal but retained until confirmation of processing completion, dynamically balancing storage retention and pruning based on real-time progress.
mechanism_raw: Checkpoints from processing applications are used to determine a cut point in the event stream. Events before the cut point are marked for expiration but retained until assurance exists that they were read, balancing retention and pruning based on processing progress.
residual_terms: ["progress indicators", "ordered event sequence", "deletion point", "processing applications", "storage retention", "pruning"]

abstract: A system for preventing magnetic saturation and for controlling and managing DC offset in a transformer cores. A magnetic flux sensor is disposed within a bore within the core transformer core. The sensor transmits a sensor output that is continuously received by a processor that is programed to continuously compare in real time the sensor output with a stored selectable maximum flux sensor output value. Responsive to the comparison of real-time sensor output value to the stored maximum value, the microprocessor either allows, during each driving voltage half-cycle, the driving voltage to continue unabated while the sensor output remains below the selectable maximum value, or triggers a gate to modify the driving voltage for the remainder of the half-cycle when the selectable maximum value is reached. The processor is also programed to process, in parallel or separately, the flux sensor output for each phase half-cycle to continuously compute a flux-second integral for each half-cycle, and to continuously compare them to each other for an instantaneous DC offset value and to add a DC voltage to the phase half-cycle that is deficient and or to subtract a DC voltage from the phase half-cycle that is contributing to the DC offset to effect minimal DC offset.
problem: Preventing magnetic saturation and controlling DC offset in transformer cores during voltage half-cycles.
constraint: Maintaining system stability by adjusting voltage in real time without disrupting ongoing operations, requiring parallel processing of sensor data and phase comparisons.
mechanism: Real-time sensor feedback is compared to a threshold to adjust driving voltage, while integrals of a measured quantity over time are computed per phase to detect and correct DC offset by applying compensating voltages.
mechanism_raw: Real-time flux sensor feedback is compared to a maximum threshold to adjust driving voltage, while flux-second integrals are computed per phase to detect and correct DC offset by adding/subtracting compensating DC voltages.

abstract: A showerhead includes a plurality of water outlets for providing a flow of water. The showerhead includes one or more lighting elements and a light driver communicably coupled to the one or more lighting elements. The light driver is configured to control at least a subset of the lighting elements to output light based on various conditions corresponding to the showerhead.
reason: The patent describes a product feature (lighting elements controlled by conditions) without a deeper causal mechanism for solving a problem beyond combining functionalities.

abstract: The present invention relates to a cutting equipment having a cutting device with a cutting element and a drive device for the cutting element. The drive device includes a pneumatically driven piston/cylinder arrangement and a switch valve having a high-pressure input port, a high-pressure output port and a low-pressure output port, with the high-pressure input port coupled to a high-pressure source, the high-pressure output port coupled to a first cylinder chamber and the low-pressure output port coupled to a second cylinder chamber. The switch valve connects the high-pressure input port to the high-pressure output port upon application of a pressurized fluid, and connects the high-pressure output port to the low-pressure output port upon reduction of the pressure level of the pressurized fluid. The present invention further relates to a clipping machine for producing sausage-shaped products, including said cutting equipment, and a method for controlling the cutting equipment.
problem: Controlling a pneumatically driven cutting device using pressure-based switching to manage piston/cylinder operation.
constraint: Ensuring reliable switching between high and low pressure states without manual intervention, requiring precise pressure sensing and valve timing.
mechanism: A switching valve changes state based on fluid pressure levels: high pressure connects input to output for actuation, while reduced pressure connects output to a low-pressure port for retraction, enabling bidirectional control via pressure thresholds.
mechanism_raw: A switch valve changes state based on pressurized fluid levels: high pressure connects input to output for actuation, while reduced pressure connects output to low-pressure port for retraction, enabling bidirectional control via pressure thresholds.

abstract: A method for performing uptower maintenance of a wind turbine in order to replace the main bearing on the turbine shaft is disclosed. Embodiments of this method to perform maintenance may include installing a rotor lock to resist rotation of the main shaft during maintenance, providing a lifting device in order to elevate the main shaft, removing the main bearing from its main bearing housing, and installing a replacement split main bearing. A crane may also be installed uptower to assist in the maintenance.
problem: Performing maintenance on a wind turbine's main bearing without dismantling the rotor or nacelle structure.
constraint: Balancing mechanical stability and accessibility in a high-wind, space-constrained environment while minimizing downtime.
mechanism: A locking mechanism prevents rotation of a shaft during maintenance, while a lifting device elevates the shaft to allow removal and replacement of a bearing in a confined environment, enabling component replacement without dismantling the structure.
mechanism_raw: A rotor lock prevents shaft rotation during maintenance, while a lifting device elevates the shaft to remove and replace the bearing in situ, enabling component replacement in a confined uptower environment.

abstract: A projector includes an illumination waveguide layer, a collimation waveguide layer, and a spatial modulator. The illumination waveguide layer expands a light beam which is coupled to the spatial modulator. The spatial modulator modulates the expanded light beam to provide a line of light points of controllable brightness. The collimation waveguide collimates light of the light points to obtain a fan of collimated light beams. Each collimated light beam of the fan has an angle corresponding to a coordinate of the corresponding light point of the line. A tiltable reflector may be placed at the exit pupil to scan the fan of light beams in a plane non-parallel to the plane of the fan, thus providing a 2D image in angular domain. An array of Mach-Zehnder interferometers may be used in place of the illumination waveguide layer and the spatial modulator to provide the line of light points.
problem: Generating a 2D image in an angular domain using a line of light points.
constraint: Maintaining precise angle-to-coordinate correspondence during scanning while preserving collimation and brightness control.
mechanism: Translating spatial positions of light sources into angular directions of collimated beams through a movable reflector, enabling two-dimensional scanning by converting spatial modulation into angular deflection while maintaining precise coordinate correspondence and beam quality control.
mechanism_raw: Mapping spatial coordinates of light points to angular directions of collimated beams via a tiltable reflector, enabling 2D scanning by converting spatial modulation into angular deflection.

abstract: A wafer inspection system and a wafer inspection equipment thereof are provided. The wafer inspection system includes a susceptor device, probe card, and bridge module. The susceptor device includes a susceptor unit for placing a wafer under test. The probe card includes a probing portion and conducting portion. The conducting portion is disposed at the periphery of the probing portion and has a contact surface. The bridge module includes transmission units extended upward, positioned adjacent to a wafer placement area, and coupled to the susceptor unit. When the probing portion comes into contact with a testing point of the wafer, the contact surface of the conducting portion gets coupled to the transmission units to transmit a test signal to the probe card via the transmission units and conducting portion and thus form a test loop. Thus, the test loop path can be shortened and the accuracy of signal transmission and inspection can be enhanced.
problem: Reducing signal path length and improving accuracy in wafer testing.
constraint: Ensuring reliable electrical coupling between the probe card and transmission units without disrupting wafer placement or probing mechanics.
mechanism: Establishing a direct electrical connection between a probing element and transmission units through physical contact during testing, reducing signal path length and improving measurement accuracy by bypassing longer conductive pathways.
mechanism_raw: Coupling a probe card's conducting portion to transmission units via physical contact during probing, creating a direct test loop that bypasses longer signal paths.

abstract: Proposed is an equipment for reducing specific air pollutants generated from heated asphalt concrete with proportional control, which includes: a dryer for heating and drying aggregates and for burning harmful gases introduced through nozzles mounted thereon; a first dust remover for removing dust from the harmful gases emitted from the dryer; a fine dust remover for filtering fine dust from the remaining gases and dust; a bypass damper for returning some of the gases and dust emitted from the first dust remover to a second dust remover; the second dust remover for filtering the dust in the gases and dust emitted from the first dust remover; and a blower for feeding the gases exhausted from the second dust remover to the dryer, wherein clean gas exhausted from the fine dust remover is emitted to the air through an exhaust fan and a stack.
problem: Reducing specific air pollutants from heated asphalt concrete processes.
constraint: Balancing recirculation flow rates to maintain heating efficiency while maximizing pollutant capture across multiple filtration stages.
mechanism: Recirculating a portion of post-filtration gases through a bypass pathway to a secondary filtration stage, then reintroducing cleaned gas to the heating process via a blower, forming a closed-loop pollutant reduction system that balances flow rates across multiple filtration stages.
mechanism_raw: Recirculating a portion of post-first-dust-remover gases through a bypass damper to a second dust remover, then reintroducing cleaned gas to the dryer via a blower, forming a closed-loop pollutant reduction system.

abstract: An adapter assembly including a power box that has a housing containing internal components, a longitudinal axis and a storage portion. The adapter assembly also includes a first cord coupled to and extending from the housing, an adapter including an engagement portion that is removably coupled to the storage portion of the housing and that selectively engages a power source-receiving portion of a tool, and a second cord having a first end coupled to the adapter and a second end coupled to the housing.
reason: The adapter assembly primarily describes a modular power connection with removable coupling, lacking a deeper causal mechanism beyond standard mechanical-electrical interfacing.

abstract: An induction cooking hob and a method for heating food as well as a computer program product are disclosed. Based on information of a micro-electromechanical system (1500) in combination with a temperature sensor associated to a heating zone, vibrations can be detected and a heating zone associated with the boiling substance can be properly discriminated from one supporting a pot having a non-boiling substance in it. Subsequent simmering of the substance can be automatically effected. An indication will be provided to a user (1680), and an automated function can be started (1610) including boiling and subsequent simmering, respectively indication of a boiling substance on any of the heating zones on an induction hob (1000).
problem: Automatically discriminating between boiling and non-boiling substances on an induction hob.
constraint: Accurately distinguishing boiling-induced vibrations from ambient noise or non-boiling disturbances without false positives.
mechanism: Detecting characteristic vibration patterns and temperature changes associated with boiling using sensor-based monitoring, enabling automated discrimination between boiling and non-boiling states by distinguishing boiling-induced disturbances from ambient noise.
mechanism_raw: Using MEMS-based vibration detection combined with temperature sensing to identify boiling states, triggering automated simmering or user alerts based on detected vibration patterns.

abstract: In a method of forming a diamond film, substrate, or window, a substrate is provided and the diamond film, substrate, or window is CVD grown on a surface of the substrate. The grown diamond film, substrate, or window has a thickness between 150-999 microns and an aspect ratio≥100, wherein the aspect ratio is a ratio of a largest dimension of the diamond film, substrate or window divided by a thickness of the diamond film. The substrate can optionally be removed or separated from the grown diamond film, substrate, or window.
problem: Creating ultra-thin, high-aspect-ratio diamond films or substrates that maintain structural integrity during growth and post-processing.
constraint: Balancing the aspect ratio (largest dimension divided by thickness) to ensure structural stability during CVD growth and subsequent substrate removal without fracturing the thin diamond layer.
mechanism: Controlled deposition process with precise thickness and aspect ratio parameters to form mechanically robust yet extremely thin structures. The substrate is selectively removed or separated after growth, leveraging the high aspect ratio to preserve the film's integrity during detachment.
mechanism_raw: Controlled chemical vapor deposition (CVD) growth with precise thickness (150-999 microns) and aspect ratio (≥100) parameters, enabling the formation of mechanically robust yet extremely thin diamond structures. The substrate can be selectively removed or separated after growth, leveraging the high aspect ratio to preserve the film's integrity during detachment.

abstract: A networked boiler system includes a first boiler, at least one secondary boiler in operative connection with the first boiler and having a plurality of internal sub boilers, a boiler control connected to one of the first or secondary boilers, and an external control connected to one of the first or secondary boilers. The boiler control enables the first boiler to control a boiler parameter of the first boiler, the at least one secondary boiler, and the plurality of internal sub boilers of the at least one secondary boiler. A method of operating a networked boiler system includes the steps of connecting a first boiler to at least one secondary boiler, the secondary boiler including a plurality of nested sub boilers; connecting the first boiler to an external control; and with a boiler control connected to one of said first boiler and said at least one secondary boiler, controlling a boiler parameter of said first boiler, said at least one secondary boiler, and said plurality of nested sub boilers of said at least one secondary boiler.
problem: Efficiently coordinating control of multiple interconnected boilers and nested sub-boilers in a networked heating system to maintain consistent operational parameters.
constraint: Ensuring seamless communication and parameter synchronization across multiple control layers (primary, secondary, sub-boilers) without introducing latency or conflicting control signals.
mechanism: Hierarchical control architecture where a central control unit manages parameters across primary and secondary processing units and their internal nested sub-units. This enables centralized oversight of distributed elements while allowing localized adjustments, reducing complexity and improving system-wide responsiveness.
mechanism_raw: Hierarchical control architecture where a boiler control unit manages parameters across a primary boiler, secondary boilers, and their internal nested sub-boilers. This enables centralized oversight of distributed heating elements while allowing localized adjustments, reducing complexity and improving system-wide responsiveness.

abstract: A first heat exchanger, a desiccant block, and a second heat exchanger are arranged in series. In a dehumidifying operation, a first operation mode and a second operation mode are alternately repeated. In the first operation mode, the first heat exchanger is operated as a condensor or a radiator and the second heat exchanger is operated as an evaporator. In the second operation mode, the first heat exchanger is operated as the evaporator and the second heat exchanger is operated as the condensor or radiator. A pressure reducing amount in the first operation mode is controlled to be smaller than in the second operation mode so that a degree of superheat in the evaporator (second heat exchanger in the first operation mode, first heat exchanger in the second operation mode) in each of the first operation mode and the second operation mode is appropriately controlled to increase a dehumidifying amount.
problem: Optimizing dehumidification efficiency in a heat exchanger system by dynamically managing superheat levels during alternating operational modes.
constraint: Balancing pressure reduction differences between modes to prevent excessive superheat (which reduces dehumidification) or insufficient superheat (which risks liquid refrigerant carryover).
mechanism: Alternating between two operational modes where heat exchangers switch roles (evaporator/condenser) and adjusting pressure reduction amounts to control superheat. In the first mode, reduced pressure reduction maintains higher superheat in the evaporator (second heat exchanger), while in the second mode, increased pressure reduction lowers superheat in the evaporator (first heat exchanger), maximizing moisture removal.
mechanism_raw: Alternating between two operational modes where heat exchangers switch roles (evaporator/condenser) and adjusting pressure reduction amounts to control superheat. In the first mode, reduced pressure reduction maintains higher superheat in the evaporator (second heat exchanger), while in the second mode, increased pressure reduction lowers superheat in the evaporator (first heat exchanger), maximizing moisture removal.

abstract: A system for emergency egress advisement from a building. An egress advisement device can receive a floormap and subset of emergency egress instructions associated with routes within the building, wherein the subset of instructions are associated with a location of the egress advisement device and are used, by the device, to direct users in proximity to the location of the device to egress from that location during an emergency, locally store the floormap and subset of instructions, receive a signal indicative of an emergency, locally select, based on real-time conditions in the building relative to the location of the egress advisement device, one of the subset of instructions, which is customized for users in proximity to the location of the egress advisement device, and output the selected instructions to guide the users in proximity to the location of the egress advisement device to egress from the building.
problem: Providing location-specific emergency egress guidance in a building during an emergency, adapting to real-time conditions without relying on centralized infrastructure.
constraint: Ensuring local devices have sufficient data and processing capability to make accurate routing decisions while maintaining synchronization with evolving emergency conditions.
mechanism: Decentralized advisement devices that locally store spatial data and emergency instructions, receive emergency signals, and autonomously select customized egress routes based on real-time conditions relative to their location. This eliminates dependency on central servers and enables immediate, context-aware guidance.
mechanism_raw: Decentralized advisement devices that locally store floor plans and emergency instructions, receive emergency signals, and autonomously select customized egress routes based on real-time conditions (e.g., fire, smoke) relative to their location. This eliminates dependency on central servers and enables immediate, context-aware guidance.

abstract: A smoking article (10) includes an aerosol-generating substrate (12) and a mouthpiece (14) that (i) includes a first hollow tubular segment (24) of elastically deformable material and (ii) is secured to a downstream end of the aerosol-generating substrate; and a second hollow tubular segment (30) adjacent to and upstream of the first hollow tubular segment. The second hollow tubular segment (30) defines a chamber (32) for receiving an insert unit (50). The first hollow tubular segment defines an opening through which an insert unit can pass from the exterior of the mouthpiece into the chamber (32) of the second hollow tubular segment. At least a portion of the first hollow tubular segment inwardly projects into the opening to define at least one elastically deformable projection (26).
problem: Facilitating reliable insertion of an insert unit into a chamber within a smoking article's mouthpiece while maintaining structural integrity during normal use.
constraint: Designing the projection's geometry and material properties to ensure sufficient elastic deformation for insertion while maintaining durability and airtight sealing under normal operating conditions.
mechanism: An elastically deformable projection inwardly projecting into an opening. When an insert unit is pushed through the opening, the projection deforms elastically to allow passage into a chamber, then returns to its original shape to seal or retain the insert. This leverages material elasticity to enable reversible mechanical interaction.
mechanism_raw: An elastically deformable projection inwardly projecting into the mouthpiece opening. When the insert unit is pushed through the opening, the projection deforms elastically to allow passage into the chamber, then returns to its original shape to seal or retain the insert. This leverages material elasticity to enable reversible mechanical interaction.

abstract: A complex flow tube for fine sealing coating of a PVC material for an automobile includes a base fixed to a mechanical arm, and a pipeline connected to the base for delivering a PVC sealant; the base is detachably butted with an interface of a PVC gluing pump mounted on the mechanical arm; the PVC gluing pump delivers the PVC sealant through the pipeline to a part to be coated or sealed of the automobile. The complex flow tube may be combined with the metal 3D printing technology, so that the manufactured complex flow tube has the advantages of being convenient to use, simple in structure, high in strength, not liable to break, etc.
problem: Creating a fluid delivery system that is both serviceable (detachable for maintenance/replacement) and structurally robust enough to withstand operational stresses without failure.
constraint: Balancing the need for detachability (for maintenance and flexibility) against structural integrity (to prevent leaks, breakage, or failure under pressure), resolved by using additive manufacturing to create a unified structure that is strong despite having a detachable interface.
mechanism: A detachable mechanical interface between two components allows quick connection/disconnection, while additive manufacturing creates a unified structure that eliminates weak joints and provides structural reinforcement compensating for the mechanical weakness introduced by the detachable coupling.
mechanism_raw: A detachable mechanical interface between the flow tube base and the pump allows quick connection/disconnection, while metal 3D printing integrates the entire flow path as a monolithic structure, eliminating weak joints and providing structural reinforcement that compensates for the mechanical weakness typically introduced by detachable couplings.

abstract: A slurry scraping mechanism and an applying and scraping device used in an SG abrasive production process includes a scraping master support; a scraper, wherein the scraper is connected with the scraping master support through a suspension component such that the scraper is suspended, and a damping spring is arranged in the suspension component; and a torsion spring adjusting component, wherein the torsion spring adjusting component includes a plurality of torsion springs supported by a torsion spring support shaft, the torsion spring support shaft is fixed to the scraping master support, the torsion spring support shaft is movable up and down relative to the scraping master support, the torsion springs are clamped in a V-shaped plate, an end side of the V-shaped plate is connected with the scraping master support, and a side surface of the V-shaped plate is connected with the scraper.
problem: Maintaining consistent contact pressure between a scraping tool and a surface during slurry application, while accommodating surface irregularities and allowing the operator to adjust the applied force.
constraint: Balancing consistent contact pressure (for uniform scraping) with surface-following compliance (to avoid damage or uneven wear) and adjustable force (for process optimization), achieved through the combination of spring-based damping and torsional force adjustment.
mechanism: A suspended tool mount with a resilient element provides passive compliance to follow surface contours, while an adjustable force mechanism with a clamping arrangement allows precise tuning of the applied force by controlling the preload transmitted to the tool.
mechanism_raw: A suspended scraper mount with a damping spring provides passive compliance to follow surface contours, while a torsion spring adjustment system with a V-shaped plate clamping arrangement allows precise tuning of the scraping force by controlling the torsional preload transmitted to the scraper.

abstract: A method for the patterning and control of single electrons on a surface is provided that includes implementing scanning tunneling microscopy hydrogen lithography with a scanning probe microscope to form charge structures with one or more confined charges; performing a series of field-free atomic force microscopy measurements on the charge structures with different tip heights, where interaction between the tip and the confined charge are elucidated; and adjusting tip heights to controllably position charges within the structures to write a given charge state. The present disclose also provides a Gibb's distribution machine formed with the method for the patterning and control of single electrons on a surface. A multi bit true random number generator and neural network learning hardware formed with the above described method are also provided.
problem: Precisely positioning individual electrons on a surface to create defined charge states for quantum device applications, without disturbing the charges during measurement.
constraint: Achieving atomic-scale positioning precision while avoiding charge perturbation from external fields, resolved by using field-free measurement conditions and tip-height feedback to manipulate charges without introducing disruptive electric fields.
mechanism: A scanning probe system creates confined charge structures, then a series of field-free measurements at varying probe heights reveal interaction dynamics, and this feedback is used to adjust probe height to controllably move charges into desired positions within the structures.
mechanism_raw: Scanning tunneling microscopy hydrogen lithography creates confined charge structures, then a series of field-free atomic force microscopy measurements at varying tip heights reveal the tip-charge interaction dynamics, and this feedback is used to adjust tip height to controllably move charges into desired positions within the structures.

abstract: A silicon carbide semiconductor device includes a semiconductor substrate, a first semiconductor layer, a second semiconductor layer, a first semiconductor region, and a gate electrode. Protons are implanted in a first region spanning a predetermined distance from a surface of the semiconductor substrate facing toward the first semiconductor layer, in a second region spanning a predetermined distance from a surface of the first semiconductor layer on the second side of the first semiconductor layer facing toward the semiconductor substrate, in a third region spanning a predetermined distance from a surface of the first semiconductor layer on the first side of the first semiconductor layer facing toward the second semiconductor layer, and in a fourth region spanning a predetermined distance from a surface of the second semiconductor layer on the second side of the second semiconductor layer facing toward the first semiconductor layer.
reason: The patent describes a standard silicon carbide semiconductor device structure created through conventional proton implantation at predetermined depths. While the specific arrangement of four implanted regions defines a particular device, the underlying technique (ion implantation for doping) is a well-established, generic semiconductor fabrication process with no novel causal mechanism that extends beyond routine application of known methods to a specific device design.

abstract: A welding tool includes a tool support and a welding torch coupled to the tool support. The welding tool is configured to rotate relative to the tool support about a welding axis. A locating device is coupled to the tool support and is movable between a retracted position and an extended position. In the extended position, the locating device extends toward the welding axis. The locating device includes a recess at an end of the locating device. The recess is configured such that, when a predetermined object to be welded (such as an anchor rod) is positioned at least partially within the recess of the locating device in the extended position, the welding axis passes through the object to be welded.
problem: Precisely aligning a rotating welding tool with an object to be welded (such as an anchor rod) so that the welding axis passes through the object, while allowing the alignment mechanism to be stowed when not in use.
constraint: Achieving precise alignment of the rotating tool with the workpiece while allowing the locating device to be retracted for tool changes, positioning, or clearance, resolved by a movable locating mechanism that self-centers the object on the rotation axis when deployed.
mechanism: An extendable locating device with a capture feature moves between a retracted position and an extended position; in the extended position, the capture feature mechanically centers the object on the rotation axis so that the rotating tool automatically aligns with the object.
mechanism_raw: An extendable locating device with a recess at its end moves between a retracted position and an extended position; in the extended position, the recess captures the object to be welded, mechanically centering it on the welding axis so that the rotating tool automatically aligns with the object.

abstract: An attic door support and trimming system includes a plurality of frame sections each having a base wall with an inner edge, an outer edge, a top side and a bottom side, a first end and a second end. A vertical wall extends upwardly from the base wall and is spaced from the inner and outer edges. The first and second ends of different frame sections are positionable against each other to form a rectangular shaped frame. The frame sections each are telescopic to allow a size of the rectangular shaped frame to be adjusted. The top side of the first flange is abuttable against the ceiling adjacent to the opening and the top of the second flange supports a cover when the cover is placed in a closed position closing the opening.
problem: Adjusting an attic door frame to fit variable opening sizes while providing structural support for the door and ceiling interface.
constraint: Balancing adjustability of the frame size with sufficient structural rigidity to support the door and maintain a seal against the ceiling.
mechanism: Interfitting adjustable structural segments form a reconfigurable frame whose overall dimensions can be varied, while independent contact elements interface with opposing surfaces to provide load-bearing support and sealing, separating dimensional adaptation from structural load transfer.
mechanism_raw: Telescopic frame sections with interlocking ends form a rectangular frame whose dimensions are adjustable, while flanges on the frame sections independently abut the ceiling and support the door cover, decoupling size adjustment from load-bearing functionality.

abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide method and device for providing service for a programmable logic controller (PLC), including: creating a virtual-functional-module-description file including an address of an input channel of a virtual functional module to be created; and creating the virtual functional module in a PLC based on the virtual-functional-module-description file, assigning the address to the input channel of the virtual functional module, and creating a virtual-functional-module-configuration file including a mapping relation between the input channel and an output of a service provider. The present disclosure proposes a concept of a virtual functional module which is used to map data provided by intelligent data sources outside the PLC to input channel of PLC so that the data can be the same as normal input values used by PLC program.
problem: Integrating external data sources into a programmable logic controller (PLC) without requiring native hardware input channels or modifying existing PLC programs.
constraint: Maintaining compatibility with existing PLC programs and hardware while enabling flexible integration of heterogeneous external data sources.
mechanism: An abstraction layer maps data from heterogeneous external sources to standardized input representations, allowing a control system to consume external data as native inputs without requiring hardware modifications or program alterations.
mechanism_raw: Creating a virtual functional module abstraction layer that maps external data sources to PLC input channels via configuration files, allowing the PLC to treat external data as native input values without hardware or program changes.
residual_terms: ["abstraction layer", "heterogeneous external sources", "standardized input representations", "control system", "native inputs"]

abstract: Provided are a vacuum freeze-drying apparatus and a method capable of continuously performing vacuum freeze-drying in a short time. A vacuum freeze-drying apparatus 1 of this invention having an exhaust path for performing vacuum suction, while a drying device 3 comprises a tubular member 31 provided an inlet portion and an outlet portion formed of a tubular shape, a temperature adjusting means 30a to 30j provided in a plurality of regions formed from the inlet portion toward the outlet portion in a peripheral portion of the tubular member 31 wherein the plurality of regions are at least three or more regions whose temperature is capable of being controlled, for adjusting temperatures of a plurality of regions 40a to 40j in outer surface of the tubular member, a temperature control unit 8 for independently controlling the temperature adjusting means, and a rotating portion 7 for rotating the tubular member 31, wherein the tubular member 31 has a spiral transfer means 31a continuously provided adjacent to an inner wall of the tubular member from the inlet portion toward the outlet portion, and the transfer means 31a transfers the frozen substance sequentially to locations corresponding to the plurality of regions in the tubular member so as to continuously sublimate and dry.
problem: Continuously performing vacuum freeze-drying of substances in a short time while ensuring uniform sublimation and material transport.
constraint: Coordinating rotational movement, spiral transfer rate, and independent temperature control across zones to ensure consistent drying without thermal shock or material degradation.
mechanism: A rotating transport element with a progressive displacement mechanism moves material through a series of independently temperature-controlled zones, enabling continuous phase transition and removal of volatile components as the material advances from entry to exit.
mechanism_raw: A rotating tubular member with a spiral transfer mechanism moves frozen substances through sequentially temperature-controlled zones, enabling continuous sublimation and drying as the material progresses from inlet to outlet.
residual_terms: ["rotating transport element", "progressive displacement mechanism", "temperature-controlled zones", "phase transition", "volatile components"]

abstract: The present invention relates to a temperature-control unit for a furnace device for heat treating a plate, in particular a metal plate. The temperature-control unit has a temperature-control body, which is arrangeable in a furnace chamber of the furnace device. The temperature-control body has a plurality of receiving bores. Furthermore, the temperature-control unit has a plurality of temperature-control pins, wherein the temperature-control pins are mounted in the receiving bores movably relative to the temperature-control body. The temperature-control pins are controllable in such a way that a temperature-control group of the temperature-control pins is extendable from the temperature-control body in the direction towards the plate, so that a thermal contact between the temperature-control group of the temperature-control pins and a predetermined temperature-control zone of the plate is generatable.
problem: Achieving precise, localized temperature control over specific zones of a plate during heat treatment without affecting adjacent regions.
constraint: Balancing pin positioning accuracy, thermal conductivity, and mechanical mobility to achieve rapid and localized temperature adjustments without cross-zone interference.
mechanism: Selectively positionable thermal contact elements can be extended to make localized thermal contact with predetermined regions of a workpiece, enabling targeted heating of specific zones while thermally isolating adjacent regions.
mechanism_raw: Movable temperature-control pins mounted in a body can selectively extend to make thermal contact with predetermined zones of the plate, enabling targeted heating while isolating non-target zones.
residual_terms: ["thermal contact elements", "localized thermal contact", "predetermined regions", "targeted heating", "thermal isolation"]

abstract: A medical image processing apparatus includes an acquisition unit and a processing unit. The acquisition unit acquires volume data of a subject. The processing unit displays a three-dimensional image by rendering the acquired volume data, on a display unit. The processing unit displays a first object showing (i) a point on a body surface of the subject and (ii) a direction to the volume data in the three-dimensional image, and displays a two-dimensional image of a surface including the point on the body surface and being defined based on the direction, in the volume data. The processing unit acquires information of a first operation to change display of the two-dimensional image, and moves the point on the body surface along the body surface of the subject based on the first operation to update display of the first object and the two-dimensional image.
problem: Navigating and updating linked 3D volume and 2D surface views in medical imaging based on user interaction with a single control point.
constraint: Maintaining real-time synchronization between 3D and 2D views while ensuring computational efficiency during interactive navigation.
mechanism: A representative point and directional indicator in a three-dimensional space drives coordinated updates to both a volumetric rendering and a planar cross-sectional view, with user manipulation of the point along a surface dynamically adjusting both displays in real time.
mechanism_raw: A first object representing a surface point and direction in 3D space drives synchronized updates to both the 3D rendering and a 2D cross-sectional view, with user input moving the point along the surface to dynamically adjust both displays.
residual_terms: ["representative point", "directional indicator", "three-dimensional space", "volumetric rendering", "planar cross-sectional view", "real time"]

abstract: A foldable multifunction chair including a base for contacting a support surface; a user body support having a support front surface for contacting a user body, the user body support being adjustably pivotably mounted to the base along a transversal axis; a selectively adjustable chair deployment mechanism cooperatively coupled to the base and the user body support, the chair deployment mechanism being configured for selectively adjusting the user body support to a desired angle relative to the base; and a locking mechanism configured for angularly locking the user body support to the desired angle relative to the base. The chair may be used, e.g., as a backrest with an accessory support positioned in front thereof for work, or as a seated workstation wherein the accessory support is positioned adjacent a rear surface of the user body support in a deployed position, and the collapsible seat in a deployed position.
problem: Creating a multifunctional chair that can be reconfigured into different operational modes (e.g., backrest, workstation) while maintaining stability in each configuration.
constraint: Balancing adjustability for multiple configurations with structural stability and user safety during transitions.
mechanism: A pivotable joint connects a user-support element to a base structure, allowing angular repositioning between multiple configurations. A deployment mechanism sets the angular position, while a locking mechanism rigidly secures the support element in the selected position, ensuring stability during use. The system enables reconfiguration between operational modes while maintaining structural integrity in each configuration.
mechanism_raw: Adjustable pivotable mounting of the user body support relative to the base, combined with a deployment mechanism to set the angle and a locking mechanism to secure it. The system allows angular adjustment and rigid fixation, enabling reconfiguration between modes.

abstract: A fixture is mounted on a work platform and contains: a first movable block, a second movable block, an actuation block, multiple resilient elements, multiple first connection blots, and a threaded bolt. The first movable block includes a first body having a first tilted face, a first defining portion, and a first clamping face. The second movable block includes a second body having a second tilted face, a second defining portion, and a second clamping face. The actuation block includes a third body having a third tilted face, a fourth tilted face, at least one first abutting portion, at least second abutting portion, and a coupling orifice. The third tilted face corresponds to the first tilted face and has a third defining portion, and the third tilted face has a fifth slide section, a sixth slide section, and a third stop section.
problem: Precisely clamping or positioning components on a work platform while allowing controlled adjustment under mechanical stress.
constraint: Maintaining consistent clamping pressure and positional accuracy while accommodating mechanical tolerances and wear.
mechanism: Opposing angled surfaces on movable elements interact to convert rotational input into linear displacement. Resilient elements bias the surfaces into contact, while a threaded actuator provides controlled force. Incremental movement along the angled surfaces enables fine positional adjustment, and the interaction of stop features locks the position under mechanical stress.
mechanism_raw: Interacting tilted faces on movable blocks and an actuation block, combined with resilient elements and a threaded bolt. Sliding sections and stop sections on the tilted faces enable incremental adjustment and locking, translating rotational motion into linear clamping force.

abstract: A handheld hydraulic-powered concrete-cutting handsaw is provided including a base. A blade guard may be provided on the base. A hydraulic blade motor may be provided on the blade guard. A sawblade may be drivingly engaged for rotation by the blade motor. A front handle and a rear handle may be removably attached to the blade guard and/or base. The handsaw can further include a removable slurry guard. A coolant manifold may be provided on the blade guard. A coolant flow control valve may be confluently connected to the coolant manifold. A coolant supply line may be confluently connected to the coolant flow control valve. A pair of coolant discharge lines may be confluently connected to the coolant manifold and discharge at opposite sides of the sawblade.
problem: Efficiently cutting hard materials like concrete in a handheld tool while managing heat, debris, and operator safety.
constraint: Balancing hydraulic power density with portability and thermal management in a handheld form factor.
mechanism: High-torque, low-speed power transmission drives a cutting element, while a dual-discharge fluid system simultaneously cools the cutting zone and contains debris. Removable protective barriers and grip elements allow adaptation to different cutting orientations and user preferences, maintaining operator safety during operation.
mechanism_raw: Hydraulic power transmission to the blade motor for high torque at low speeds, paired with a dual-sided coolant discharge system that cools the blade and suppresses slurry. Removable guards and handles allow adaptability to different cutting scenarios.
residual_terms: ["high-torque, low-speed power transmission", "dual-discharge fluid system", "removable protective barriers"]

abstract: A smart toilet (100) includes an information acquisition device (110) and a control device (120). The information acquisition device (110) is configured to acquire feature information of the smart toilet (100) in a working state, the feature information at least including voiceprint information and odor information, or voiceprint information, or odor information of a human body using the smart toilet (100). The control device (120) includes an identity recognition component (121) configured to recognize, according to the feature information, the identity of the human body using the smart toilet (100). An electric appliance system including the smart toilet (100) is further included.
problem: Identifying users in a non-traditional environment (e.g., toilet) using biometric data to enable personalized appliance control.
constraint: Achieving reliable identification accuracy in a noisy, variable environment with minimal sensor intrusion.
mechanism: Multiple distinct biological or behavioral signatures are captured by separate sensing modalities and processed by a recognition engine to authenticate identity. Upon successful authentication, context-specific control signals are generated to adjust appliance settings according to the identified user's preferences.
mechanism_raw: Multi-modal biometric sensing (voiceprint and odor) to capture unique human features, processed by an identity recognition component to authenticate users and trigger context-specific appliance responses.
residual_terms: ["multiple distinct biological or behavioral signatures", "recognition engine", "context-specific control signals"]

abstract: A liquid phase enhanced oil recovery system that, in a stimulation phase, pumps a liquid mixture of propane (C3) and butane (C4) having a starting ratio of C3 to C4 into a well. During a subsequent production phase, liquid C3 and liquid C4 is recovered by a stabilizer from the produced oil, and, in addition, C3 and C4 can be recovered from the produced hydrocarbon vapor and liquefied, The ratio of liquid C3 to liquid C4 can then be re-adjusted and may not be the same as the starting ratio. All of the liquid C3-C4 can be recycled back into the well in subsequent stimulation phases. The method works at relatively low pressures, so that a pump or pumps can be used for stimulation treatment. The site equipment is compact enough that it can be mounted on one or more skids to ensure transportability to be used on other wells.
problem: Enhancing oil recovery from wells at low pressures while minimizing equipment complexity and enabling chemical reuse.
constraint: Optimizing the C3/C4 ratio dynamically to balance oil mobility and chemical recovery efficiency under low-pressure constraints.
mechanism: A mixture of two hydrocarbon components is injected into a subsurface formation to reduce fluid viscosity and enhance extraction. During production, the separated components are analyzed and their ratio is dynamically adjusted before recycling, maintaining optimal mobility and recovery efficiency across repeated cycles without requiring high-pressure infrastructure.
mechanism_raw: Injecting a propane-butane mixture into a well to reduce oil viscosity, then recovering and re-adjusting the ratio of separated hydrocarbons during production. The rebalanced mixture is recycled, maintaining efficacy across cycles without high-pressure infrastructure.

abstract: A lock and lid lock for an appliance are provided. The lock has a base supporting a driving mechanism, a sliding mechanism, a connecting mechanism and a locking mechanism. The driving mechanism includes a driving unit that drives rotation of a screw rod. A sliding block is connected to a gear that is engaged with the screw rod and drives the sliding block to move linearly back and forth with the rotation of the screw rod. One end of the connecting mechanism is connected to the sliding block and the other end is connected to the locking mechanism. This allows linear movement of the sliding block to be converted into rotational movement of the locking mechanism. The locking mechanism is rotatably connected to the base and may include a locking portion which is configured to unfold or retract relative to the base along with the rotation of the locking mechanism.
problem: Converting linear motion into rotational motion for a locking mechanism in a compact appliance lock, where space is limited but reliable actuation is required.
constraint: The motion conversion must occur within a compact envelope while maintaining reliable and repeatable locking/unlocking action under mechanical load.
mechanism: A rotating drive element produces linear displacement of a follower through a mechanical interface; a linkage then transforms this linear displacement into rotational motion of a locking member, enabling selective engagement or disengagement of a locking feature relative to a base structure within a confined spatial envelope.
mechanism_raw: A screw rod rotates to drive a gear and sliding block in linear motion; a connecting mechanism (linkage) then converts this linear displacement into rotational movement of a locking member, which unfolds or retracts a locking portion relative to the base.
residual_terms: ["screw rod", "gear", "sliding block", "connecting mechanism", "linkage", "rotational movement", "locking member", "unfolds or retracts", "locking portion", "base"]

abstract: A headborne attachment platform includes multiple rigid plates and straps of connecting material connecting the rigid plates in an assembly at independently selectable and pre-set distances apart from each other. The assembly of rigid plates is shaped and connected to sit adjacent to, and surround, the bone regions of a wearer's skull, and define an overall headgear shape and contour. The straps are more flexible than the rigid plates in directions perpendicular to the thickness of the straps, and the straps are inelastic in a direction of a length thereof. A tightening mechanism is configured to adjust a circumference of a headband region, and the rigid plates have mounting features configured to mount an outer helmet shell and/or a headborne device. The rigid plates are sufficiently rigid to support and maintain their three-dimensional shape when subjected to forces exerted upon them by the outer helmet shell or headborne device.
problem: Creating a headgear system that maintains a predetermined three-dimensional shape under external loads (e.g., from a mounted helmet or device) while allowing the wearer's head-contact geometry to be adjusted.
constraint: The connecting straps must simultaneously provide flexibility for positional adjustment and inextensibility along their length to maintain structural shape integrity when subjected to forces from mounted equipment.
mechanism: Rigid structural elements are interconnected by flexible tension members that exhibit directional compliance—flexible in directions perpendicular to their primary axis but inextensible along their primary axis. This allows repositioning of the structural elements at selectable separations while preventing dimensional change along the member length, thereby preserving overall shape integrity and load-bearing capability under external forces.
mechanism_raw: Rigid plates are connected by straps that are flexible in directions perpendicular to their thickness but inelastic along their length; this allows the plates to be repositioned at selectable distances while the inelastic length direction prevents dimensional change, preserving the overall headgear shape and load-bearing capability.
residual_terms: ["rigid plates", "straps", "flexible in directions perpendicular to their thickness", "inelastic along their length", "headgear"]

abstract: A method for manufacturing an optical fiber preform including a core part and a cladding part is disclosed. The method includes: adding an alkali metal to an inner surface of a silica-based glass pipe; etching the inner surface of the silica-based glass pipe to which the alkali metal is added; making a glass rod by collapsing the silica-based glass pipe after the etching; and making an optical fiber preform using the glass rod. The silica-based glass pipe is heated in the adding such that a surface temperature of the silica-based glass pipe falls within a temperature range of 1500° C. or higher to lower than 2000° C.
problem: Manufacturing an optical fiber preform with a core and cladding structure requires precise control over the internal geometry of the silica-based glass pipe.
constraint: The surface temperature during alkali metal addition must remain within 1500°C to 2000°C to balance etching efficiency and glass stability.
mechanism: Chemical etching of an inner surface of a tubular glass body using a reactive agent to modify surface chemistry and create a structured interface, followed by temperature-controlled thermal deformation to form a solid rod. The temperature constraint ensures structural integrity during collapse while enabling selective material removal.
mechanism_raw: Controlled chemical etching of the inner surface of a silica-based glass pipe using an alkali metal, followed by thermal collapsing to form a glass rod. The alkali metal modifies the surface chemistry, enabling selective etching to create a structured core-cladding interface, while the temperature-controlled heating ensures structural integrity during collapse.

abstract: A thickness estimation method may include: obtaining a test spectrum image; obtaining test spectrum data; measuring a thickness of a test layer formed on the test substrate at the plurality of positions; generating a regression analysis model using a correlation between the thickness of the test layer and the test spectrum data; obtaining a spectrum image; and estimating a thickness of a target layer over the entire area of the semiconductor substrate by applying the spectrum image to the regression analysis model. The thickness corresponding to the entire area of the semiconductor substrate that is being transferred is estimated using the thickness estimation method according to an exemplary embodiment in the present disclosure, such that whether or not processing is normally performed may be examined without requiring a separate time. In addition, an examination result may be feedbacked to processing equipment to improve production yield.
problem: Estimating the thickness of a layer across an entire semiconductor substrate without requiring time-consuming point-by-point measurements.
constraint: The accuracy of the regression model depends on the strength of the correlation between spectral data and thickness, requiring representative training data.
mechanism: Building a predictive model from spectral data correlated with reference measurements, then applying the model to spatially resolved spectral data across a substrate to infer a property distribution non-invasively. The model's accuracy depends on the strength of the spectral-property correlation.
mechanism_raw: Using spectral data from a test substrate to build a regression model that correlates spectral features with measured thickness values. This model is then applied to a full-area spectrum image of the target substrate to infer thickness distribution rapidly and non-invasively.

abstract: An aircraft control system 100 operably connected to a landing gear and a landing gear bay door of an aircraft 400. The system includes: a user interface 10 to receive manual inputs of first and second requests and a landing gear controller 20 configured to: receive a first indication indicative of user-operation of the user interface to input the first request, and to initiate movement of the landing gear bay door from a closed position to an open position on the basis of the first indication without initiating movement of the landing gear between an extended position and a retracted position; and receive a second indication indicative of user-operation of the user interface to input the second request, and to initiate movement of the landing gear between the extended position and the retracted position on the basis of the second indication.
problem: Separating the operation of a landing gear bay door and the landing gear itself to prevent unintended mechanical interference during aircraft operations.
constraint: The user interface must clearly distinguish between the two requests to avoid ambiguous or conflicting commands.
mechanism: Separating user commands into independent control channels for two mechanically coupled systems, ensuring actuation of one system does not trigger movement in the other. The controller enforces logical isolation between the two command streams to prevent conflicting operations.
mechanism_raw: Decoupling user inputs into two distinct requests: one for door movement (open/close) and another for gear extension/retraction. The controller processes these inputs independently, ensuring door actuation does not trigger gear movement and vice versa.

abstract: An alumina/titanium silicon carbide composite material is prepared by making titanium aluminum carbide (Ti3AlC2) in uniform contact with silicon monoxide (SiO), and carrying out vacuum sintering. The composite material is obtained through mutual diffusion of aluminum and silicon and has high compactness and stable performance. In the composite material, the alumina is generated by means of a reaction between the titanium aluminum carbide and the silicon monoxide, and can be uniformly wrapped around surfaces of titanium silicon carbide crystals to form a relatively compact oxide film, such that substance exchange between a matrix and the outside is hindered, and overall antioxidation of the composite material is improved. Toughness of the composite material is enhanced by means of the titanium silicon carbide. The prepared composite material has relatively high purity, relatively low sintering temperature, and relatively high bending strength. The process is simple and convenient for industrial production.
problem: Creating a composite material with high oxidation resistance and mechanical toughness while maintaining a simple, low-temperature manufacturing process.
constraint: The vacuum sintering process must be carefully controlled to ensure complete diffusion and avoid defects in the composite structure.
mechanism: Inducing in-situ formation of a protective oxide layer through mutual diffusion of elements during solid-state sintering under controlled atmosphere. The self-forming oxide uniformly coats matrix crystals, enhancing environmental resistance while the matrix provides mechanical toughness.
mechanism_raw: Mutual diffusion of aluminum and silicon during vacuum sintering of titanium aluminum carbide and silicon monoxide generates alumina in situ, which uniformly coats titanium silicon carbide crystals. This self-forming oxide layer hinders substance exchange with the environment, while the titanium silicon carbide matrix enhances toughness.

abstract: A method and apparatus for measuring a melt back of a seed in a boule are provided. The method includes lifting a boule once it has been produced using an actuating device onto a support table to automatically manipulate the boule from a furnace to the support table. The melt back of the seed is then automatically measured using a vision system that is installed on an imaging device disposed below the boule.
problem: Automatically measuring the melt back of a seed in a boule after production without manual intervention or complex repositioning.
constraint: The vision system must be precisely aligned relative to the boule's position on the support table to ensure accurate imaging.
mechanism: Automated transfer of a workpiece from a processing station to a measurement station, followed by fixed-position imaging of a region of interest using a vision system. The fixed alignment eliminates manual repositioning and enables repeatable quantification of geometric changes.
mechanism_raw: Lifting the boule from a furnace to a support table using an actuating device, then employing a vision system positioned below the boule to image and measure the melt back. The automated transfer and fixed imaging setup eliminate manual handling and enable consistent, repeatable measurements.

abstract: An edge protection system for use with concrete flooring, including a first part for coupling to an edge portion of a first concrete flooring panel and a second part for coupling to an opposed edge portion of a second, neighbouring, concrete flooring panel, and a support foot for supporting the system relative to a ground surface, wherein the first part has a pair of vertically opposed longitudinal rails, and the support foot has an engagement formation which has an unlocked orientation for inserting the formation between the opposed rails to abut against the first part and a rotated, locked orientation wherein the formation is locked by the rails against lateral withdrawal from the first part.
problem: Securing an edge protection system to adjacent concrete flooring panels while preventing lateral withdrawal of the support foot.
constraint: The system must allow insertion of the foot between the rails without pre-alignment while ensuring secure locking against lateral forces once rotated.
mechanism: A rotational interlock mechanism where an engagement formation is inserted between opposed longitudinal rails in an unlocked orientation, then rotated to a locked orientation where the rails constrain lateral withdrawal.
mechanism_raw: A rotational interlock mechanism where an engagement formation is inserted between opposed longitudinal rails in an unlocked orientation, then rotated to a locked orientation where the rails constrain lateral withdrawal.
residual_terms: ["rotational interlock", "engagement formation", "longitudinal rails", "unlocked orientation", "locked orientation", "lateral withdrawal"]

abstract: Stacked nanosheet complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor field effect transistor devices include a lower semiconductor channel sheet on a substrate. An upper semiconductor channel sheet is on the substrate above the lower semiconductor channel sheet. The upper semiconductor channel sheet is a different semiconductor material than the lower semiconductor channel sheet. A dielectric substitute partition sheet is on the substrate between the upper semiconductor channel sheet and the lower semiconductor channel sheet.
reason: The patent describes a specific layered semiconductor structure with material differentiation and dielectric isolation, but does not present a generalizable causal mechanism beyond material arrangement in a fixed configuration.

abstract: This present application discloses a disposable toothbrush head product that cleans the teeth and removes plaque, food particles and other unwanted debris from the mouth easily and safely. The disposable toothbrush head product is an individually wrapped, thin plastic or rubber toothbrush head with a series of shorter bristles. The bristles are coated with an activatable toothpaste, gel or other tooth cleaning solution. The brush head can be adhered to a finger using adhesive or a plastic ring for cleaning the teeth. Additionally, the product is a convenient toothbrush option for individuals looking to clean teeth while away from home.
reason: The patent describes a disposable product combining pre-applied cleaning agents and finger adhesion, but lacks a causal mechanism for solving a broader problem beyond the specific product design.

abstract: A system and method for cleaning, rinsing, and sanitizing a container is disclosed. The system has a sanitizing agent chamber for storing a sanitizing agent, the one or more solution chambers in fluid communication with the container, a pump in fluid commination with the sanitizing agent, wherein the pump is in communication with a gas, and at least one spray nozzle fluidly connected to the at least one solution chamber via a conduit positioned within the container, wherein the spray nozzle comprises a housing inside which the sanitizing agent is mixed at pressure with the gas to disperse the sanitizing agent and gas mixture into the container for sanitizing the container.
problem: Efficiently cleaning and sanitizing containers by mixing and dispersing a sanitizing agent without manual intervention.
constraint: The system must balance pressure, gas flow, and agent concentration to ensure effective dispersion while maintaining fluid communication between chambers and the container.
mechanism: Pressurized mixing of a sanitizing agent with a gas inside a spray nozzle housing, enabling dispersion of the agent-gas mixture into the container for sanitization.
mechanism_raw: Pressurized mixing of a sanitizing agent with a gas inside a spray nozzle housing, enabling dispersion of the agent-gas mixture into the container for sanitization.

abstract: Disclosed are a rotational joint and a product for children having the rotational joint. The rotational joint includes a first connecting base, a second connecting base and a base rotationally connected about a same rotation center line, the rotational joint further includes a linkage member, and the linkage member is arranged in such a manner that the linkage member is capable of only linearly moving relative to the base; the linkage member and the first connecting base is provided with a first guide slot and a first guide pillar the linkage member and the second connecting base is provided with a second guide slot and a second guide pillar The rotational joint can be used for products for children, such as strollers and child sitting saddles, to realize linked unfolding and folding of the respective rod members.
problem: Enabling coordinated folding and unfolding of rod members in children's products like strollers through a rotational joint.
constraint: The joint must allow independent rotation of the bases while ensuring the linkage member's linear motion remains synchronized to prevent binding or misalignment during folding.
mechanism: A linkage member constrained to linear motion via guide slots and pillars relative to two rotating bases, translating rotational movement into synchronized linear displacement for linked folding.
mechanism_raw: A linkage member constrained to linear motion via guide slots and pillars relative to two rotating bases, translating rotational movement into synchronized linear displacement for linked folding.
residual_terms: ["linkage member", "linear motion", "guide slots", "pillars", "rotating bases", "rotational movement", "synchronized linear displacement", "linked folding"]

abstract: A solar power generation network shut-off unit includes a first circuit breaker and second circuit breakers. The first circuit breaker is provided to a power line connecting a plurality of solar power generation modules and a power conditioner in series, and shut-off the supply of power from the solar power generation modules through the power line and transmits an emergency shut-off signal when an emergency shut-off button is pressed. The second circuit breakers are provided to each of a plurality of solar power generation modules, and shut-off the supply of power from the plurality of solar power generation modules through the power line and transmit a shut-off completion signal to the first circuit breaker when an emergency shut-off signal is received from the first circuit breaker.
problem: Need to safely and verifiably shut off power from distributed solar modules during an emergency, ensuring every module is disconnected before confirming system-wide shutdown.
constraint: The system must balance rapid emergency response with guaranteed completeness — every module must be confirmed disconnected before the master declares shutdown, preventing premature re-energization while avoiding single points of failure in the signaling path.
mechanism: A hierarchical control system with bidirectional acknowledgment: a master controller broadcasts an emergency shut-off command to distributed slave controllers; each slave independently executes local disconnection upon receiving the command, then transmits a completion acknowledgment back to the master; the master only confirms full system shutdown after receiving acknowledgments from all slaves, creating a closed-loop verification of distributed disconnection.
mechanism_raw: A hierarchical cascade control with bidirectional acknowledgment: a master circuit breaker broadcasts an emergency shut-off signal to slave circuit breakers at each module; each slave independently executes local disconnection upon receiving the signal, then transmits a shut-off completion signal back to the master; the master only confirms full system shutdown after receiving completion acknowledgments from all slaves, creating a closed-loop verification of distributed disconnection.

abstract: A garment assembly system including a fixture including an opening, an abutment surface formed in either the fixture or a housing disposable on the fixture, and a carrier. The carrier is disposable in the opening. The carrier is moveable between a retracted position and an extended position. In the extended position, the carrier is configured to press an open first joint of a tubular component disposed on the carrier and an open second joint of a base component disposed on the fixture together against the abutment surface.
problem: Need to reliably join an open end of a tubular component to an open end of a base component in a repeatable, controlled manner during automated garment assembly.
constraint: The carrier must achieve precise positioning and sufficient force to join the joints without damaging components, while the retracted position must allow unobstructed loading and unloading — balancing actuation travel, force output, and cycle accessibility.
mechanism: A carrier moves linearly between a retracted position (for loading) and an extended position; in the extended position, the carrier's motion applies compressive force that presses the open first joint of the tubular component and the open second joint of the base component together against a fixed abutment surface, mechanically joining them through controlled displacement-driven pressure.
mechanism_raw: A carrier moves linearly between a retracted position (for loading) and an extended position; in the extended position, the carrier's motion applies compressive force that presses the open first joint of the tubular component and the open second joint of the base component together against a fixed abutment surface, mechanically joining them through controlled displacement-driven pressure.
residual_terms: ["carrier", "linear motion", "retracted position", "extended position", "abutment surface", "compressive force", "displacement-driven pressure"]

abstract: In a method of making a lifter bar for use in a grinding mill, a refurbished lifter bar and a mould for producing the refurbished lifter bar, the lifter bar has a predetermined form and has a base member, and the method includes providing a mould having an interior space that conforms at least partially to the predetermined form, joining the mould and the base member together to form a cavity defined by the base member and the interior space, and filling the cavity with polymer and allowing the polymer to attach to the base member to construct a lifter bar having the predetermined form.
problem: Need to refurbish a worn lifter bar for a grinding mill by rebuilding its functional shape onto an existing base member without replacing the entire component.
constraint: The mold must conform precisely to the target geometry while the polymer must adequately adhere to the base member — balancing dimensional accuracy of the rebuilt shape against material compatibility and bonding strength at the interface.
mechanism: A mold conforming to the desired functional geometry is joined to an existing base member to form a sealed cavity between the mold interior and the base surface; a material is then injected or poured into this cavity and allowed to cure, bonding to the base member and reconstructing the predetermined form using the base as an integral part of the molding substrate.
mechanism_raw: A mold conforming to the desired lifter bar geometry is joined to the existing base member to form a sealed cavity between the mold interior and the base surface; polymer is then injected or poured into this cavity and allowed to cure, bonding to the base member and reconstructing the lifter bar's predetermined form using the base as an integral part of the molding substrate.

abstract: The invention is about a stabilized electromagnetic base liquid, as well as its preparation method and its application in the high-salt wastewater treatment. The raw material components of the electromagnetic base fluid include: 20-30 parts of alkali metal hydroxides(e.g., as sodium hydroxide); 20-30 parts of non-alkali metal (e.g., as silicon or phosphorus); 2-6 parts of ammonia; 31-140 parts of water; after treatment with a direct electrical current the parameters of the stabilized electromagnetic base liquid are: pH value: 12 to 14; oxidation reduction potential value: −1.0 to −1.8 v; with no corrosivity, confirming the presence of stabilized hydrated electrons (eaq−−). With the stabilized electromagnetic base liquid, the storage problem of the electromagnetic base liquid is solved, and the large-scale application in the industrial field can be realized, thereby achieving a large-scale high-salt wastewater treatment process with low cost, high recovery rate.
problem: Need to stabilize highly reactive hydrated electrons (eaq−−) in an electromagnetic base liquid so the liquid can be stored long-term and deployed at industrial scale for high-salt wastewater treatment.
constraint: The composition and electrical treatment must balance three competing requirements simultaneously: maintaining high pH for electron stability, achieving sufficiently negative redox potential to preserve ea q−−, and eliminating corrosivity — any imbalance destabilizes the reactive species or renders the liquid unusable.
mechanism: A specific compositional blend of chemical components is subjected to direct electrical current treatment, which drives the system to a stabilized state with controlled pH and oxidation-reduction potential that preserves reactive species in a non-corrosive form, enabling practical storage and large-scale application.
mechanism_raw: A specific compositional blend of alkali metal hydroxides, non-alkali metal compounds, ammonia, and water is subjected to direct electrical current treatment, which drives the system to a stabilized state with controlled pH (12–14) and oxidation-reduction potential (−1.0 to −1.8 V) that preserves hydrated electrons in a non-corrosive form, enabling practical storage and large-scale application.
residual_terms: ["compositional blend", "direct electrical current treatment", "pH", "oxidation-reduction potential", "hydrated electrons", "non-corrosive form"]

abstract: A knitted metal fabric of at least two rows of loops, the rows of loops comprising metal chain knitted together to form a knitted metal fabric. The metal chain comprises a plurality of links of metal linked together to form the chain. The knitted metal chain fabric may be made into garments or used in any manner as other fabrics. A method for making the fabric includes providing at least one metal chain of links flexibly linked together, feeding the metal chain into a knitting machine, maintaining an even tension on the chain, knitting the metal chain into a knitted pattern to form a fabric, and weighting the fabric.
problem: Need to convert discrete metal chain links into a continuous knitted fabric structure suitable for use as a flexible metal textile.
