Confinement within a chamber allows mechanical shearing and fluid forces to subdivide the gas into small dispersed bubbles. The resulting high surface area and extended residence time of these bubbles in the liquid enable enhanced mass transfer driven by concentration gradients between the gas and liquid phases.
mechanism_raw: Impeller rotation creates a low-pressure zone that draws gas through a conveyance tube into the impeller interface, where gas and liquid mix. The gas-liquid mixture chamber confines the forming bubbles, allowing the impeller's shearing action and liquid forces to break them into micro-sized bubbles (<0.85mm). These small bubbles have a long residence time (gas hold-up) in the liquid, and the concentration gradient between the gas inside the bubbles and the surrounding liquid drives diffusion of gas into the liquid, achieving a high transfer rate.

abstract: A forming die assembly for microcomponents includes a forming die, a plunger, and a punch. The forming die is formed with a cavity, a storage portion for storing a raw material with a metal powder and a binder having plasticity, and a punch hole that connects the cavity and the storage portion so as to form a gate therebetween. The plunger is formed so as to be slidably inserted into the storage portion and to fill the raw material stored in the storage portion into the cavity through the punch hole. The punch is slidably inserted into the plunger in the sliding direction of the plunger and opens and closes the gate by reciprocatory sliding. The punch closes the gate and compresses the raw material in the cavity into a green compact by sliding in the direction of the cavity.
problem: Forming microcomponents from metal powder-binder raw material requires precise control over material filling into a cavity and subsequent compression into a green compact, without contamination or incomplete forming.
constraint: The tradeoff between the precision of sequential plunger and punch coordination (to ensure complete cavity filling before compression) and the mechanical complexity of achieving independent reciprocation of two coaxial sliding elements within a confined space.
mechanism: Two coaxial sliding elements are coordinated to sequentially perform material delivery and compression. One element transports raw material through an aperture into a cavity while the other element reciprocally opens and closes the aperture—when open, material fills the cavity; when closed, the second element applies compressive force to form a consolidated green compact. This sequential coordination ensures complete cavity filling prior to compression.
mechanism_raw: A plunger slides within a storage portion to push raw material through a punch hole (gate) into the cavity. A separate punch slides within the plunger to reciprocatorily open and close the gate—when the gate is open, the plunger fills the cavity; when the gate is closed, the punch compresses the raw material already in the cavity into a green compact. This sequential coordination of plunger filling and punch gate-valving/compression ensures controlled material delivery and forming pressure.

abstract: An aisle containment system is provided. The aisle containment system includes a pair of wall beams suspended from a ceiling, a pair of floor tracks positioned beneath the wall beams and secured to a floor, and at least one blanking panel secured to one of the wall beams and one of the floor tracks.
reason: The aisle containment system is a static structural assembly—suspended wall beams, floor tracks, and blanking panels arranged to form a physical barrier. There is no dynamic causal operation, feedback loop, or functional process that produces an effect through a mechanism; it is simply a product configuration describing how components are physically connected to create a containment barrier.

abstract: A more IM compliant grenade fuze assembly includes a fuze body, an energetics train disposed in the fuze body, and a striker lever rotatably attached to the fuze body. A spring-loaded rotor assembly is rotatably fixed to the fuze body. The rotor assembly includes a primer. A firing pin is disposed in one of the rotor assembly and the fuze body. Placing the primer in the rotor assembly decreases the area of the fuze assembly that is vulnerable to initiation by impact from a bullet, fragment, or shape charge.
problem: Grenade fuze assemblies are vulnerable to accidental initiation when external impacts (bullets, fragments, shape charges) directly strike sensitive components like the primer.
constraint: The fuze must remain reliably triggerable by its intended firing mechanism (striker lever) while being resistant to accidental initiation from external impacts.
mechanism: Use a resilient, movable isolation element positioned between a sensitive initiation component and external impact sources. The element mechanically decouples the sensitive component from direct impact forces by rotating or translating to absorb and redirect energy away from the component, reducing the effective vulnerable area while maintaining a separate, dedicated triggering pathway for intended activation.
mechanism_raw: Placing the primer within a spring-loaded, rotatably mounted rotor assembly that mechanically isolates the primer from external impact forces. When an impact occurs, the rotor rotates or moves to absorb and redirect the impact energy away from the primer, reducing the effective vulnerable area of the fuze assembly.

abstract: A bi-directional multiple-layer extension cigar holder comprises a receiving body mounted on extension tubes which are adapted for adjusting the length of the holder for holding different lengths of cigars. The cigar holder can be combined with a lighter, enhancing the use convenience. In addition, elastic retaining rings in the cigar holder which are used to avoid disengagement are big-area C-shaped plates, such that the assembly convenience can be enhanced, synchronously enhancing the effect of preventing the disengagement of the extension tubes.
problem: An adjustable-length holder needs to accommodate different sizes of items while preventing accidental disengagement of its extension components, and assembly must remain convenient.
constraint: Must balance assembly convenience (easy flexing and positioning) with retention strength (sufficient grip to prevent accidental disengagement).
mechanism: Employ a flexible retaining element with an enlarged contact interface to balance assembly compliance and retention strength. The increased contact area distributes forces over a broader region, enabling easier deformation during assembly while simultaneously increasing grip and resistance to unintended disengagement through enhanced frictional and mechanical interaction.
mechanism_raw: Using large-area C-shaped flexible plates as retaining elements. The enlarged contact area distributes retention forces over a broader region, which simultaneously makes assembly easier (the plate flexes over a larger area with less localized stress) and strengthens retention (greater contact area provides better grip and anti-disengagement force).

abstract: Fertilizers may include one or more additives that render the fertilizer more resistant to further processing such as thermal processing and/or aqueous-based processing that may otherwise be employed in the attempt to produce explosive materials from the fertilizer. The one or more additives may include materials that increase the chances of detection by providing a visual or olfactory indication of further processing. The one or more additives may include materials that make further processing more difficult or dangerous.
problem: Commonly available fertilizers can be chemically processed into explosive materials, creating security vulnerabilities.
constraint: The additives must not significantly impair the fertilizer's agricultural utility or effectiveness as a soil amendment.
mechanism: Incorporate functional additives into a base material that introduce self-deterrent or self-indicating properties. The additives either increase the risk or difficulty of further processing (deterrent) or generate detectable signals (visual, olfactory, or chemical) that reveal attempted transformation, thereby discouraging misuse or enabling identification of tampering.
mechanism_raw: Incorporating additives into the fertilizer that make it self-deterrent and self-indicating. The additives either increase the difficulty or danger of further processing (deterrent), or provide visual or olfactory signals that reveal attempted processing (detection), thereby discouraging or exposing misuse.

abstract: An embedded micro-electro-mechanical system (MEMS) (100) comprising a semiconductor chip (101) embedded in an insulating board (120), the chip having a cavity (102) including a radiation sensor MEMS (105), the opening (104) of the cavity at the chip surface covered by a plate (110) transmissive to the radiation (150) sensed by the MEMS. The plate surface remote from the cavity having a bare central area, to be exposed to the radiation sensed by the MEMS in the cavity, and a peripheral area covered by a metal film (111) touching the plate surface and a layer (112) of adhesive stacked on the metal film.
problem: A MEMS radiation sensor embedded in a semiconductor chip needs protection from environmental damage while still allowing radiation to reach the sensor through the chip surface.
constraint: Must balance radiation transmission through the bare central area with structural integrity and protection provided by the covered peripheral area.
mechanism: Apply a multi-layer protective structure with spatially selective coverage over a sensor cavity. A central region is left unobstructed to permit functional exposure (e.g., radiation transmission), while a peripheral region is sealed with barrier layers (e.g., metal film, adhesive) to provide structural integrity and environmental isolation, creating a tradeoff between exposure and protection.
mechanism_raw: Using a multi-layer plate covering the cavity opening where the central area is left bare (radiation-transparent) to allow sensing, while the peripheral area is covered with a metal film and adhesive layer for structural support and environmental protection. This selectively shields the structure while maintaining functional exposure of the sensor.

abstract: A liner stop for retaining a flow sleeve relative to a combustion liner in a combustor is disclosed. The liner stop includes a female component defining a recess and a male component comprising a protrusion, the protrusion insertable in the female component. The liner stop further includes an insert disposable between the female component and the male component, the insert comprising a surface protrusion configured to interfere with one of the female component or the male component.
problem: A flow sleeve must be securely retained relative to a combustion liner in a combustor, where high temperatures and vibrations could cause loosening or failure of the connection.
constraint: Must maintain secure retention under high-temperature and vibratory operating conditions while still permitting assembly and disassembly.
mechanism: Insert an intermediate component with a geometric protrusion between mating interfaces to establish a controlled interference fit. The protrusion's shape and dimensions determine the retention force profile, allowing the joint to be tuned for specific holding characteristics while preserving assembly/disassembly capability under operational stress conditions.
mechanism_raw: Using an intermediate insert with a surface protrusion disposed between male and female components to create a controlled interference fit. The insert's protrusion geometry determines the retention characteristics, allowing the joint to be tuned for specific holding force while maintaining assembly capability.

abstract: A method for using a lip coloring apparatus includes inserting a lip coloring applicator into a reservoir of lip color and twisting a cap attached to the lip coloring applicator relative to a body containing the reservoir. The method further includes mating a tab of the cap with a cut-out in the body to secure the cap and body to one another.
problem: Securing a cap to a container body after use without additional fastening components.
constraint: The interlock must remain secure during handling while allowing easy manual release when needed.
mechanism: Rotational motion of a closure element causes a protrusion on the closure to engage a recess in the container body, creating a mechanical interlock through geometric alignment that remains secure during handling but allows manual release via reverse rotation.
mechanism_raw: Twisting the cap causes a tab on the cap to engage a cut-out in the body, mechanically interlocking the two parts through rotational motion and geometric alignment.

abstract: An organic light emitting device and a method for manufacturing the same are provided. The organic light emitting device comprises: a substrate; a first electrode disposed on the substrate; a hole function layer disposed on the first electrode; a first emission layer disposed on the hole function layer; a second emission layer disposed on the first emission layer; an electron function layer disposed on the second emission layer; and a second electrode disposed on the electron function layer, wherein the hole function layer and the first emission layer are melted.
problem: Forming layered organic electronic structures with precise material interfaces during manufacturing.
constraint: The melting process must avoid damaging adjacent layers while achieving the desired structural or compositional integration.
mechanism: Selective thermal activation of specific functional layers during fabrication creates bonded or blended material regions at interfaces, enhancing structural or compositional integration while avoiding thermal damage to adjacent layers through controlled energy application.
mechanism_raw: Selective melting of specific functional layers (e.g., hole function layer and first emission layer) during fabrication to create bonded or blended material regions that enhance device performance.
residual_terms: ["selective thermal activation", "functional layers", "bonded or blended material regions", "controlled energy application"]

abstract: A grinding disk used for a food waste disposer includes a knocking disk base, a long strip knocking plate, at least two knocking blocks and rivets. The long strip knocking plate is arranged on the lower surface of the knocking disk base. The knocking blocks are movably and symmetrically mounted to the knocking disk base via the rivets, and each knocking block includes a cushion block for connection of the rivets and a knocking block head pivotally connected to the cushion block. When the knocking disk base is rotated with the shaft of an electric motor, the cushion block of the knocking block drives the knocking block head to slide, such that the knocking block head rotates about the rivet to hammer an object, and the cushion block can also move up and down and hammer the object while rotating and sliding.
problem: Efficiently breaking down food waste through dynamic impact forces in a confined grinding chamber.
constraint: The movement of the blocks must balance structural durability with sufficient range of motion to maximize impact coverage.
mechanism: A rotating base drives pivotable and slidable impact elements through mechanical linkages, converting rotational motion into multidirectional hammering actions within a confined chamber to break down material via dynamic impact forces.
mechanism_raw: Movable knocking blocks pivot and slide relative to a rotating base, converting rotational motion into multidirectional hammering actions via riveted joints and cushion block linkages.
residual_terms: ["rotating base", "pivotable and slidable impact elements", "mechanical linkages", "multidirectional hammering actions"]

abstract: An actuator for operating a fill valve of a bottle filling machine, said actuator having a camshaft provided with a cam fork on its inner end adapted to engage cam follower means on a fill valve, and having a trip lever on its outer end adapted to engage a rotating shoulder means on a turntable of the machine, the camshaft being rotatable within a sleeve bearing, wherein a braking means comprising a helical wave spring is mounted over the camshaft to provide a desired frictional resistance to rotation of the camshaft within the bearing for preventing rotational drift of the cam fork from its desired operating position.
problem: Preventing unintended rotational drift of a cam fork in a mechanical actuator while maintaining precise positioning.
constraint: The frictional resistance must be sufficient to prevent drift but low enough to allow intentional repositioning.
mechanism: A resilient element applies controlled frictional resistance to rotational movement of a positioning component, stabilizing its angular orientation without fully restricting motion, enabling resistance to unintended drift while permitting intentional repositioning.
mechanism_raw: A helical wave spring mounted over the camshaft applies controlled frictional resistance to rotation, stabilizing the cam fork's position without fully restricting movement.

abstract: A rear derailleur is basically provided with a base member, a movable member, a chain guide, a friction element, a one-way clutch and an electric actuator. The base member is configured to be mounted to a bicycle. The movable member is movably coupled to the base member. The chain guide is coupled to the movable member to rotate around a rotational axis with respect to the movable member. The friction element is operatively arranged between the movable member and the chain guide to frictionally provide rotational resistance in a first rotational direction of the chain guide. The one-way clutch is operatively disposed between movable member and the chain guide to engage the friction element as the chain guide rotates in the first rotational direction. The electric actuator is operatively coupled to the one-way clutch to control the one-way clutch between a clutch-on mode and a clutch-off mode.
problem: Controlling rotational movement of a chain guide in a derailleur system to enable both manual and automated operation.
constraint: The system must balance manual override capability with automated precision, ensuring smooth transitions between modes without unintended slippage.
mechanism: A directional engagement mechanism couples rotational movement of a guide element to a friction interface in one direction, while an actuator selectively enables or disables the coupling to switch between manual override and automated control modes, ensuring smooth transitions without unintended slippage.
mechanism_raw: A one-way clutch engages a friction element when the chain guide rotates in one direction, while an electric actuator selectively enables or disables the clutch to switch between manual and automatic control modes.
residual_terms: ["directional engagement mechanism", "friction interface", "actuator", "manual override", "automated control modes"]

abstract: In embodiments of the present invention improved capabilities are described for operating a node in a wireless mesh network to scan each one of a plurality of channels received at a processing node in a wireless mesh network in a predetermined order for a predetermined duration to detect a preamble; detect the preamble on one of the plurality of channels; remain on a current one of the plurality of channels to receive a message after the predetermined duration when the preamble includes a predetermined series of symbols; and resume scanning each one of the plurality of channels after the message is received.
problem: A wireless mesh node needs to monitor multiple communication channels for incoming messages while conserving power and maintaining network responsiveness, but continuously scanning all channels wastes energy and may miss messages.
constraint: The node must balance scanning all channels (to avoid missing messages) against staying on a channel long enough to receive a complete message, while keeping the scanning duration and symbol pattern fixed to maintain predictable power consumption and network timing.
mechanism: A monitoring device cycles through a set of communication pathways in a fixed sequence, spending a predetermined interval on each pathway to detect the presence of an incoming signal. When a signal matching a specific recognition pattern is identified, the device interrupts the cycling routine and remains on the detected pathway to fully receive the incoming data, then resumes the cycling routine afterward. This combines a periodic scanning process with an event-driven retention behavior triggered by a particular signal signature.
mechanism_raw: The node scans each channel in a predetermined order for a fixed duration looking for a preamble; when a preamble containing a predetermined series of symbols is detected, the node abandons the scanning schedule and remains on that channel to receive the full message, then resumes scanning afterward. This couples a periodic scanning routine with an event-driven hold-on-channel behavior triggered by a specific symbol pattern.

abstract: A messaging frame can be used to allow different domains to communicate in an electronic environment that are otherwise prevented from directly communicating. A messaging frame or other communication element can be configured to receive messages or communications from any frame, object, or element in the same domain as the messaging frame. The messaging frame then can switch to a target domain in order to provide the message or communication to a frame, object, or element in the target domain. The messaging frame can include an interface definition that allows only approved messages to be passed between domains, such that the risk of malicious attack is minimized.
problem: Different domains in an electronic environment are otherwise prevented from directly communicating, yet need to exchange messages safely without exposing either domain to malicious attack.
constraint: The mechanism must balance communication capability with security: it must allow necessary inter-domain messaging while restricting passage to only approved messages, preventing malicious or unauthorized data from crossing domain boundaries.
mechanism: A controlled intermediary entity receives messages from elements within its own domain and selectively delivers them to a target domain. An interface definition filters which messages are approved for passage, so only sanctioned communications traverse the domain boundary, preventing unauthorized or malicious data from crossing.
mechanism_raw: A messaging frame acts as a controlled intermediary that receives messages from any element in its own domain, then switches to a target domain to deliver the message. An interface definition filters which messages are approved for passage, so only sanctioned communications traverse the domain boundary.

abstract: A system and method of generating energy by transforming energy from a low-density substance, such as airflow or wind, into kinetic energy by directing the flow through a wind guide system towards panels that rotate in generally the same direction as the airflow. Furthermore, the system uses the ground and/or water as a surface for guiding the airflow towards the windmill devices. The system is made of lightweight, inexpensive tension compression construction. The tension compression system is weighted at the outermost ends of the wind-engaging panels to create a moment of inertia device capable of evening out the peaks typical of wind power generation.
problem: Wind power generation produces highly variable output with peaks and troughs due to inconsistent airflow, and the system must be lightweight and inexpensive while smoothing out this variability.
constraint: The system must be constructed from lightweight, inexpensive tension-compression materials while still providing sufficient distributed mass at the panel extremities to create enough rotational inertia to smooth out wind variability.
mechanism: A fluid flow is directed through a guide system toward rotating panels, and the outermost ends of the panels are weighted to create a distributed moment of inertia. This inertia stores kinetic energy during high-flow periods and releases it during low-flow periods, evening out the output variability.
mechanism_raw: Airflow is directed through a wind guide system toward rotating panels, and the outermost ends of the panels are weighted to create a distributed moment of inertia. This inertia stores kinetic energy during high-flow periods and releases it during low-flow periods, evening out the power generation peaks.

abstract: A laser processing system includes: a numerical control device (1) outputting a laser output signal and a digital signal; a converter (231) converting the laser output signal to an analog signal; a pulse signal generator (22) generating a pulse signal for controlling the analog signal; an auxiliary controller (7) generating a logic signal which forcedly controls transmission/stop of a laser beam; a logical operation unit (28, 29) outputting a result of the logical operation between the pulse signal and the logic signal; a switching device (27) generating a laser drive signal for alternately transmitting/stopping the laser output on the basis of the logical operation result; and a sensor (6) for measuring intensity of light radiated or reflected from a workpiece irradiated with a laser beam. The auxiliary controller (7) generates the logic signal in accordance with the intensity of the light measured by the sensor (6).
problem: Laser processing requires precise control of laser beam transmission and interruption based on real-time feedback about the workpiece's condition, rather than relying solely on pre-programmed signals.
constraint: The system must balance the programmed laser output timing with real-time sensor feedback, ensuring that the logical combination of pre-programmed and feedback signals produces precise laser control without introducing excessive latency or instability.
mechanism: A sensor measures a physical property of the workpiece. An auxiliary controller generates a logic signal based on this measured property. A logical operation unit combines this feedback-derived logic signal with a programmed pulse signal, and the result drives a switching device that alternately transmits or stops the beam.
mechanism_raw: A sensor measures light intensity reflected or radiated from the workpiece. An auxiliary controller generates a logic signal based on this measured intensity. A logical operation unit combines this feedback-derived logic signal with a pulse signal from the numerical control device, and the result drives a switching device that alternately transmits or stops the laser beam.

abstract: There may be provided an apparatus, that may include an input/output (IO) circuit; a micro-controller; a memory module that is arranged to store multiple type identification information and multiple type configuration information; wherein the multiple type identification information allows the apparatus to be identified as being of each one of multiple types of peripheral cards; and wherein the multiple type configuration information allows the apparatus to operate each one of the multiple types; wherein the micro-controller is arranged, following a selection of a selected type out of the multiple types: to expose, to a host—that is coupled to the apparatus, a selected portion of the multiple peripheral identification information that indicates that the apparatus has a functionality of a peripheral card of the selected type; and to configure the peripheral card to interact with the host as being a peripheral card of the selected type.
problem: A single peripheral card device needs to be identified and configured as different types of peripheral cards depending on the host system's requirements, without requiring separate physical devices for each type.
constraint: The device must convincingly present itself as only the selected peripheral type to the host while internally retaining the ability to switch to any other stored type, requiring isolation between the active configuration and the stored alternatives.
mechanism: The device stores multiple type identification and configuration information internally. After a type is selected, the controller exposes only the selected type's identification information to the host and configures the device's operational parameters to match that selected type, effectively adopting a new functional identity on demand.
mechanism_raw: The device stores multiple type identification and configuration information internally. After a type is selected, the microcontroller exposes only the selected type's identification information to the host and configures the device's operational parameters to match that selected peripheral type, effectively adopting a new functional identity on demand.

abstract: A chainwheel has a chainwheel body, a first combining hole set and a second combining hole set. The chainwheel body has a center point. The first combining hole set has multiple first combining holes that are formed through the chainwheel body. The first distances between the first combining holes and the center point are equal. The second combining hole set has multiple second combining holes that are formed through the chainwheel body. The second distances between the second combining holes and the center point are equal. The second distance is longer than the first distance. Therefore, the chainwheel can be combined with crank modules of different sizes by the first combining holes and the second combining holes.
problem: A chainwheel needs to be compatible with crank modules of different sizes without requiring separate chainwheel designs for each crank size.
constraint: The chainwheel must maintain structural integrity and proper load distribution through the chainwheel body while accommodating two distinct radial hole patterns, ensuring that neither set of holes compromises the mechanical strength needed for power transmission.
mechanism: The body includes two sets of attachment holes formed through it: a first set at a shorter radial distance from the center and a second set at a longer radial distance. By providing attachment points at two different radii, the body can be combined with modules of different sizes using the appropriate hole set.
mechanism_raw: The chainwheel body includes two sets of combining holes formed through it: a first set at a shorter radial distance from the center and a second set at a longer radial distance. By providing attachment points at two different radii, the chainwheel can be combined with crank modules of different sizes using the appropriate hole set.

abstract: Focused libraries of vectors or genetic packages that display, display and express, or comprise a member of a diverse family of antibody peptides, polypeptides or proteins and collectively display, display and express, or comprise at least a portion of the focused diversity of the family. The libraries have length and sequence diversities that mimic that found in native human antibodies.
reason: The patent describes a library design with specific diversity parameters but does not explain a causal mechanism that produces a useful effect through functional relationships.

abstract: The present invention provides a method which enables a steel wire to be highly strengthened with maintaining good ductility. Specifically, the present invention provides a method comprising: subjecting a high carbon steel wire material having carbon content of 0.85 to 1.10 mass % to a pre-stage drawing process with a predetermined magnitude of drawing, to form an intermediate wire material; subjecting the intermediate wire material formed by the pre-stage drawing process to a patenting treatment in which tensile strength of the wire material is adjusted to a range of 1323 to 1666 MPa; then subjecting the patented steel wire material to a subsequent drawing process including the final drawing.
problem: Achieving high tensile strength in steel wire while maintaining ductility.
constraint: Carbon content must be between 0.85–1.10 mass %, and patenting treatment must adjust tensile strength to 1323–1666 MPa to avoid brittleness.
mechanism: A multi-stage forming process where an initial deformation step creates an intermediate material state, followed by a heat treatment that adjusts mechanical properties to a target range, and a final deformation step that achieves a balance between strength and ductility.
mechanism_raw: A multi-stage drawing process where pre-drawing creates an intermediate material, followed by a patenting treatment that adjusts tensile strength to a specific range, and final drawing to achieve the desired balance of strength and ductility.

abstract: Provided is a structure for improving performance of a micro electro mechanical system (MEMS) microphone by preventing deformation from occurring due to a residual stress and a package stress of a membrane and by decreasing membrane rigidity. A MEMS microphone according to the present disclosure includes a backplate formed on a substrate; an insulating layer formed on the substrate to surround the backplate; a membrane formed to be separate from above the backplate by a predetermined interval; a membrane supporting portion configured to connect the membrane to the substrate; and a buffering portion formed in a double spring structure between the membrane and the membrane supporting portion.
problem: Preventing deformation in MEMS microphone membranes caused by residual and package stress while reducing rigidity.
constraint: The buffering portion must balance stress isolation with sufficient structural support to maintain membrane position and acoustic performance.
mechanism: A compliant coupling between a functional surface and a support structure uses a flexible element to isolate the surface from external stresses while maintaining positional stability and performance characteristics.
mechanism_raw: A double spring structure between the membrane and supporting portion acts as a buffering element, decoupling stress from the membrane while allowing controlled flexibility.

abstract: The invention relates to the soybean variety designated A1037391. Provided by the invention are the seeds, plants and derivatives of the soybean variety A1037391. Also provided by the invention are tissue cultures of the soybean variety A1037391 and the plants regenerated therefrom. Still further provided by the invention are methods for producing soybean plants by crossing the soybean variety A1037391 with itself or another soybean variety and plants produced by such methods.
reason: The patent merely describes a plant variety and its propagation methods without explaining a causal mechanism that solves a technical problem through functional relationships.

abstract: A wireless charger installed with a two-dimensional moving mechanism which is simply configured, inexpensive and can be easily miniaturized is provided wherein a table is freely moved in the X-axis direction and the Y-axis direction. In the two dimensional moving mechanism, each pair of X axis pinions are arranged to simultaneously mesh with teeth near both ends of each rack arranged on an X axis slider and Y axis slider respectively. Each pair of pinions are driven by each motor and rotated in synchronization.
problem: Creating a simple, low-cost, miniaturized two-dimensional movement mechanism for wireless charging systems.
constraint: Pinion pairs must rotate in synchronization to maintain alignment and prevent binding during simultaneous X-Y movement.
mechanism: Coordinated rotation of multiple gear pairs, each engaging with a linear guide on a respective axis, enables controlled planar displacement through synchronized mechanical actuation without complex control systems.
mechanism_raw: Synchronized rotation of paired pinions meshing with racks on X and Y axis sliders enables coordinated planar motion without complex gearing or actuators.

abstract: A detecting method of abnormality of a differential signal receiving terminal of a liquid crystal displaying module, including: inputting high level signals to LVDS0+, LVDS0−, LVDS1+, LVDS− in order, in which only one high level signal is inputted to one of the differential signal lines and the other differential signal lines are kept in high impedance states simultaneously; and receiving feedback signals from all the differential signal lines and determining whether the differential signal lines of detecting units are abnormal or not according to the received feedback signals. The abnormality of the differential signal lines includes terminal resistive opens of the differential signal lines, a short circuit between two adjacent groups of differential signal lines, and short circuits of the differential signal lines to ground or to a power supply caused by abnormal power supplying sequence. By inputting high level signals to the differential signal lines in order and receiving the feedback signal from each differential signal line, the abnormality of the receiving terminal can be detected quickly according to the received feedback signals. This not only reduces the labor cost and time cost, but also improves the detecting efficiency of the abnormality.
problem: Detecting faults (opens, shorts, power sequence issues) in differential signal lines of a liquid crystal display module quickly and efficiently without manual intervention.
constraint: Only one line is actively driven at a time, requiring precise control of signal states and feedback analysis to avoid interference between lines.
mechanism: Sequentially activating individual signal paths while maintaining non-interfering states in other paths, then analyzing feedback signals across all paths to detect anomalies. This isolates each path for testing and uses feedback to infer faults.
mechanism_raw: Sequentially applying high-level signals to individual differential signal lines while keeping others in high-impedance states, then analyzing feedback signals from all lines to identify abnormalities. This isolates each line for testing and uses feedback to infer faults.

abstract: An imaging apparatus includes, a diffraction grating that diffracts an electromagnetic wave emitted from an electromagnetic wave source, a shield grating including a shield portion that prevents transmission of the electromagnetic wave and a plurality of transmission portions that allows the electromagnetic wave to transmit therethrough, and a detector that detects the electromagnetic wave transmitted through the transmission portions of the shield grating. The diffraction grating forms an interference pattern in a grid pattern by diffracting the electromagnetic wave; the shield grating has the plurality of transmission portions arranged two-dimensionally; and a ratio of an area of the transmission portion to the area of a unit pattern composed of a portion of the shield portion and one transmission portion of the plurality of transmission portions is larger than 0.25.
problem: Improving the efficiency or resolution of electromagnetic wave imaging by forming a structured interference pattern while maintaining sufficient transmission of the wave through a shield grating.
constraint: The transmission-to-shield area ratio must exceed 0.25 to ensure adequate wave throughput while preserving the grid structure for interference pattern formation.
mechanism: Combining a structured interference element to create a grid-patterned interference pattern with a shielding element containing two-dimensionally arranged transmission regions. The ratio of transmission area to unit pattern area (>0.25) balances structural integrity and wave transmission.
mechanism_raw: Combining a diffraction grating to create a grid-patterned interference pattern with a shield grating that has two-dimensionally arranged transmission portions. The ratio of transmission area to unit pattern area (>0.25) balances structural integrity and wave transmission.

abstract: A radiator for domestic heating with a heat-transfer fluid operating in two-phase form includes a reservoir of the heat-transfer fluid; a hot source, intended to raise the temperature of the heat-transfer fluid to a temperature such that it causes said fluid to undergo a change of phase; and a heater, at which the heat transfer with ambient air takes place, having n channels, communicating in a lower zone with the reservoir, it being possible for n to be equal to 1. The heat-transfer fluid is a mixture of at least two different heat-transfer liquids, the heat-transfer liquids having between them boiling points differing by at least ten degrees Celsius, and the liquid with the lowest boiling point representing 70% to 95% of the volume of the mixture for a mixture temperature of about 20° C.
problem: Enhancing heat transfer efficiency in a domestic heating radiator operating with a two-phase heat-transfer fluid.
constraint: The boiling point differential and volume ratio must be tightly controlled to ensure the lower-boiling component dominates phase transitions without destabilizing the mixture.
mechanism: Using a mixture of at least two substances with boiling points differing by ≥10°C, where the lower-boiling-point substance constitutes 70–95% of the volume. This composition optimizes phase-change dynamics to improve heat dissipation.
mechanism_raw: Using a mixture of at least two heat-transfer liquids with boiling points differing by ≥10°C, where the lower-boiling-point liquid constitutes 70–95% of the volume. This composition optimizes phase-change dynamics to improve heat dissipation.

abstract: In a vehicle steering system, when a sensor malfunction determination unit detects a malfunction of a rotation angle sensor, the sensor malfunction determination unit changes a control mode from a first control mode to a second control mode. In the second control mode, an actual rotor angle (mechanical angle) (θSM) of a steered system motor is computed on the basis of a second rotor angle (electric angle) (θSE2) estimated by a rotation angle estimation unit. Then, feedback control is executed such that the actual rotor angle (θSM) converges to a target rotor angle (θSM1*) that is obtained by superimposing a rotation maintaining command signal on a target rotor angle (θSM*) computed by a target rotor angle computation unit.
problem: Maintaining vehicle steering control when a rotation angle sensor malfunctions.
constraint: The estimation of the mechanical angle from the electric angle must be sufficiently accurate to maintain control stability during sensor failure.
mechanism: Switching from a primary control mode (using direct sensor input) to a secondary mode that estimates the mechanical angle from an electric angle signal. Feedback control then drives the estimated angle to a target derived from a superimposed command signal.
mechanism_raw: Switching from a primary control mode (using direct sensor input) to a secondary mode that estimates the rotor's mechanical angle from an electric angle signal. Feedback control then drives the estimated angle to a target derived from a superimposed command signal.

abstract: There is disclosed a method and apparatus for separating plastics from compost material. In an embodiment, the method comprises: providing an inclined trough having a feed entry at a top end and a materials discharge end at a bottom end, the inclined trough including a plurality of riffles positioned substantially perpendicularly to a direction of flow of compost material down the inclined trough; inducing a vibration in the inclined trough to induce a prolonged period of hindered unsettling in the compost material; providing a longitudinal dam to at least one side of the inclined trough; and generating an air flow over a substantial length of the inclined trough perpendicular to the direction of flow of compost material down the inclined trough, thereby to blow plastics separated from the compost material over the longitudinal dam.
problem: Separating plastics from compost material efficiently using mechanical and aerodynamic forces.
constraint: The vibration frequency and airflow velocity must be balanced to separate plastics without disrupting the compost flow or causing re-entanglement of materials.
mechanism: Inducing vibration in an inclined trough with surface features to prolong hindered unsettling of compost, while generating airflow perpendicular to the material flow direction. This blows separated plastics over a longitudinal dam, leveraging differences in material aerodynamics and vibration response.
mechanism_raw: Inducing vibration in an inclined trough with riffles to prolong hindered unsettling of compost, while generating airflow perpendicular to the material flow direction. This blows separated plastics over a longitudinal dam, leveraging differences in material aerodynamics and vibration response.

abstract: The present invention discloses an iron-type golf club head having a body with at least one sole pocket and a cap sized to at least partially close the sole pocket. The pocket is bounded on one side by a face plate, which is only partially affixed to the body via welding, and may be completely or partially filled with the cap. The cap, which can be made of multiple materials having different densities, is located within the pocket such that one or more gaps are disposed between the cap and the sidewalls of the pocket.
problem: Adjusting weight distribution and center of gravity in a golf club head while maintaining structural integrity.
constraint: Balancing adjustable weight distribution against the need for sufficient structural attachment to prevent failure during impact.
mechanism: A partially attached component with variable-density regions and controlled spacing between the component and a base structure enables localized mass tuning. The spacing decouples the component from the base, allowing independent deformation or vibration damping while the partial attachment preserves structural continuity.
mechanism_raw: A partially affixed cap with variable-density materials and controlled gaps between the cap and pocket sidewalls allows localized mass tuning. The gaps decouple the cap from the body, enabling independent deformation or vibration damping while the partial welding preserves structural continuity.

abstract: A method of forming a roadway is provided comprising providing a reclaimer-stabilizer machine, providing in-situ soil materials, forming a base layer using the reclaimer-stabilizer machine, forming a wear layer over the base layer, and wherein the wear layer comprises a polyurethane composition in addition to the in-situ materials. In some embodiments the roadway is comprised of a single layer comprising a polyurethane material. In other embodiments a method of forming a roadway comprising cured asphalt composite is provided.
problem: Creating durable roadways using in-situ soil materials with minimal reliance on external aggregates or binders.
constraint: Optimizing polymer-to-soil ratios to achieve structural strength without excessive material costs or environmental impact.
mechanism: Combining native in-situ materials with a binding agent during mechanical mixing stabilizes a base layer through polymer-induced cohesion. The binding agent acts as a matrix that enhances load-bearing capacity while integrating local materials, reducing reliance on transported resources.
mechanism_raw: Combining in-situ soil with a polyurethane composition during mechanical reclamation stabilizes the base layer through polymer-induced cohesion. The polyurethane acts as a binding matrix that enhances load-bearing capacity while integrating native materials, reducing the need for transported resources.

abstract: A bra with embroidered support regions that provide support without compression is provided. The embroidered support regions are constructed by stitching a configurable thread pattern on a middle layer of a bra cup. The configurable thread pattern includes a plurality of top threads and a plurality of bobbin threads that are arranged to provide support in needed areas.
problem: Providing targeted biomechanical support in a wearable garment without compressing soft tissue.
constraint: Maintaining comfort and flexibility in non-support regions while ensuring sufficient tensile strength in embroidered zones.
mechanism: Configurable thread arrangements stitched into a fabric layer create localized tensioned zones that resist deformation under load. The thread configuration mimics structural reinforcement principles, distributing forces through the material while avoiding uniform compression in non-support regions.
mechanism_raw: Configurable thread patterns (top and bobbin threads) stitched into a middle layer create localized tensioned zones that resist deformation under load. The thread arrangement mimics structural reinforcement principles, distributing forces through the fabric while avoiding uniform compression.

abstract: A crimping tool for applying a seal to strap material includes a tool head having pairs of jaws disposed in the tool head and operably mounted thereto, each pair including opposingly oriented jaw elements. Each pair of jaws is spaced from its adjacent pair and includes an upper and lower pivot openings. A shear is positioned between adjacent pairs of jaw elements. The shears extend between the jaw elements and include opposing openings that align with the jaw element upper openings. A pair of handles, each having a terminal end having first openings that align with the jaw element lower openings and are operably connected to one another at respective pivot openings. The tool includes at least one side plate having a pair of upper openings each aligned with the jaw element upper openings and the shear openings. The plate includes a centrally disposed notched opening. A pair of handle pins are disposed in respective handle first openings and jaw element lower openings and a pair of link pins are disposed in respective side plate upper openings and respective jaw element upper openings and a shear opening. A pivot pin is disposed in the side plate notched opening and in the handle pivot openings. The shear can be reversible to accommodate different sizes of seals.
problem: Performing multiple mechanical operations (crimping, shearing, and sealing) on strap material in a single tool stroke.
constraint: Ensuring precise alignment of forces across multiple pivot axes to avoid misalignment or binding during operation.
mechanism: A multi-functional tool with aligned pivot axes and reversible cutting elements enables sequential crimping and shearing actions. The tool's linkage system translates input motion into coordinated jaw closure and shear activation, with adjustable spacing accommodating different operational parameters.
mechanism_raw: A modular jaw-shear assembly with aligned pivot points and reversible shear elements enables sequential crimping and cutting actions. The tool's linkage system translates handle motion into coordinated jaw closure and shear activation, with adjustable spacing accommodating different seal sizes.

abstract: Propelling device or engine to transform potential energy into power, using the forces produced movement of a liquid surface or fluid or similar, more specifically, the device is made arranged means to exploit synergistic four forms of surface displacement of the fluid wave, objectively the upward, downward, forward wave toward the shore and pulling inward, in order to produce conventional and renewable energy more efficient than currently used systems with minimal mechanical efforts, whose employment is varied, for pumps, single or hydraulic; to generate electricity, to generate the movement of maritime vessels of any size or movement of vehicles or land machinery land, for hydropower generation, etc.
problem: Efficiently converting fluid surface displacement into usable mechanical or electrical energy with minimal input effort.
constraint: Maximizing energy capture across variable wave conditions while minimizing mechanical complexity and maintenance requirements.
mechanism: Exploiting multi-directional fluid motion through a system of displacement chambers or surfaces that sequentially capture and amplify kinetic energy. The coordinated interaction of these motions creates a cumulative force multiplication effect, driving mechanical or electrical energy conversion systems.
mechanism_raw: Exploiting synergistic four-directional fluid wave motion (upward, downward, forward, inward) through a system of displacement chambers or surfaces that sequentially capture and amplify kinetic energy. The coordinated interaction of these motions creates a cumulative force multiplication effect, driving pistons, turbines, or hydraulic systems.

abstract: A split idle station assembly for a transfer press assembly includes a track assembly, a first base assembly slidably connected to the track assembly and a second base assembly slidably connected to the track assembly. The first and second base assemblies have a support configuration with the first base assembly adjacent the second base assembly forming a work piece support assembly for supporting a work piece thereon between work stations of the transfer press assembly. The first and second base assemblies have a split configuration where the first base assembly is moved apart from the second base assembly along the track assembly.
problem: Need to support a work piece between work stations of a transfer press while also being able to separate the support for operational access or work piece removal.
constraint: The system must maintain stable and continuous work piece support in the support configuration while allowing smooth, controlled splitting motion of the two base assemblies along the track without losing positional integrity.
mechanism: A pair of base assemblies mounted on a shared track can transition between an adjacent support configuration, where they form a continuous support surface for a work piece, and a separated configuration, where they are moved apart along the track to create access for operational intervention or work piece removal. A coupling mechanism maintains positional integrity between the assemblies during the transition, ensuring stable support in the support configuration and controlled splitting motion in the separated configuration.
mechanism_raw: Two base assemblies mounted on a shared track assembly can transition between a support configuration, where they are adjacent and form a continuous work piece support surface, and a split configuration, where they are moved apart along the track to separate the support. This allows the same assembly to provide stable support during processing and then split open for access when needed.

abstract: Pressurized gas for carrying looper thread by gas is generated by gas supply pump operated by changing over a sewing-machine motor, which drives stitch forming device, looper threading is performed through loopers by one-touch operation. Gas carrying threading device of sewing machine, comprising: looper thread introduction mechanism inserts looper thread guided to loopers; hollow looper thread guide extends from looper thread introduction mechanism to looper thread inlets and has looper thread guide outlets; gas supply pump for performing looper threading by carrying looper thread by gas from looper thread introduction area through hollow looper thread guide to looper thread loop-taker point outlets; clutch for transmitting power from sewing machine motor M to drive shaft which drives stitch forming device including loopers at time of stitch formation or to gas supply pump at time of looper threading.
problem: Need to perform both stitch formation and looper threading in a sewing machine using a single motor, avoiding the need for separate motors or manual threading.
constraint: The single motor must be shared between two distinct operational modes (stitching and threading), requiring reliable and automatic selective power transmission via the clutch without manual intervention or conflict between the two functions.
mechanism: A single motor drives two distinct operational subsystems through a selective power routing mechanism. A clutch automatically switches power transmission between the two subsystems based on operational mode: during normal operation, power is routed to the primary processing device; during setup operation, power is routed to a fluid generation device that delivers pressurized fluid through hollow guides to complete automatic configuration of the processing device.
mechanism_raw: A clutch selectively routes power from a single motor to either the stitch forming device (during normal stitching operation) or a gas supply pump (during threading operation). When threading is needed, the clutch engages the gas pump, which generates pressurized gas that carries looper thread from an introduction area through hollow looper thread guides to the looper inlets, completing the threading automatically.

abstract: A method for modernizing an ammonia synthesis loop (1) with a first converter (10) and a second converter (11) in series, the first converter (10) comprises a cartridge with one or more catalyst beds, the second converter (11) comprises a catalyst bed in direct contact with said vessel, the method comprising the steps of removing the second converter, and boosting the first converter by replacing the cartridge with a high-efficiency cartridge comprising a plurality of adiabatic catalyst beds and inter-bed heat exchangers, or an isothermal catalyst bed, and by reducing the concentration of inerts in said first converter.
problem: Need to improve the efficiency of an ammonia synthesis loop that uses two converters in series, where the second converter adds complexity and the first converter has limited heat management.
constraint: The upgraded cartridge must fit within the existing first converter vessel while providing enhanced internal heat management through inter-bed heat exchange, and the inert concentration must be reduced sufficiently to improve efficiency without compromising system stability.
mechanism: A multi-stage catalytic processing unit consolidates heat recovery and chemical conversion within a single vessel by arranging multiple catalyst beds with inter-stage heat exchange elements between them. The inter-stage heat exchange recovers thermal energy between catalyst stages, enabling improved temperature control and higher conversion efficiency. Additionally, the concentration of non-reactive diluent gases is reduced to enhance reaction kinetics without compromising system stability.
mechanism_raw: The second converter is removed and the first converter is upgraded by replacing its cartridge with a high-efficiency cartridge that incorporates multiple adiabatic catalyst beds with inter-bed heat exchangers (or an isothermal catalyst bed), along with reducing the concentration of inert gases in the first converter. The inter-bed heat exchangers recover heat between catalyst stages within a single cartridge, enabling better temperature control and higher conversion efficiency in a consolidated unit.
residual_terms: ["catalyst beds", "inter-stage heat exchange", "non-reactive diluent gases", "conversion efficiency", "reaction kinetics"]

abstract: Disclosed is an engine control system which is designed to allow homogeneous-charge compression ignition combustion to be performed in an HCCI region (R) defined as an engine operating region including at least a partial-load range of an engine. In a low load zone (R1) of the HCCI region (R), a lift amount of an intake valve (11) is set to a first predetermined value, and an exhaust valve (12) is allowed to start being opened during an intake stroke at a given timing later than an opening timing of the intake valve (11). Further, in the medium load zone of the HCCI region, the lift amount of the intake valve (11) is gradually increased up to a second predetermined value greater than the first predetermined value, along with an increase in an engine load. The engine control system is capable of adequately controlling an amount of burned gas to be introduced into a cylinder, depending on the engine load to allow the HCCI combustion to be adequately performed in a wider engine load range.
problem: Need to control homogeneous-charge compression ignition (HCCI) combustion across a wider engine load range, particularly in low and medium load zones where burned gas recirculation must be precisely managed.
constraint: Intake valve lift and exhaust valve timing must be precisely coordinated to control burned gas recirculation while maintaining stable HCCI combustion, with the valve parameters transitioning smoothly between load zones to avoid combustion instability.
mechanism: An adaptive valve control system coordinates intake flow regulation and exhaust timing based on engine load zones to manage internal gas recirculation. In the low load zone, intake flow is set to a first predetermined level and exhaust is timed to open during the intake stroke at a delay relative to intake opening. In the medium load zone, intake flow is progressively increased toward a second, higher predetermined level as load increases. This coordinated adjustment of flow and timing controls the amount of residual gas recirculated into the combustion chamber, enabling stable combustion across the load range.
mechanism_raw: The system adaptively controls both intake valve lift and exhaust valve timing based on engine load zones. In the low load zone, the intake valve is set to a first predetermined lift value and the exhaust valve is opened during the intake stroke at a timing later than the intake valve opening. In the medium load zone, the intake valve lift is gradually increased up to a second, greater predetermined value as engine load increases. This coordinated control of valve lift and timing regulates the amount of burned gas recirculated into the cylinder, enabling stable HCCI combustion across the load range.
residual_terms: ["intake valve lift", "exhaust valve timing", "engine load zones", "burned gas recirculation", "HCCI combustion", "combustion chamber"]

abstract: A composition comprising at least one nutrient element, wherein the at least one nutrient element possesses a relative energy-state value greater than the relative energy-state value of the at least one nutrient element in a preexisting state, the composition being effective, perhaps because of the greater energy-state value, to improve the ability of a soil, when combined with the composition, to support plant growth better than the soil, when not combined with the composition. Also a composition comprising at least one nutrient element, wherein the composition possesses an energy spectrum more positive than the energy spectrum of the composition in a preexisting state, the composition being effective, perhaps because of the more positive energy spectrum, to improve the ability of a soil, when combined with the composition, to support plant growth better than the soil, when not combined with the composition. Methods of making and using the same for improving soil, plants, plant growth, seeds, and/or plant products, including quality of plant products, are also disclosed, as well as improved soil, seeds, including quality of seeds, plants, and/or plant products, including quality of plant product.
reason: The abstract claims that nutrient elements with higher energy-state values or more positive energy spectra improve soil plant growth, but uses speculative language ('perhaps because of') without explaining a clear causal mechanism for how the energy state produces the beneficial effect. It describes a composition property rather than a functional problem-solving mechanism.

abstract: Provided is breakaway adjustable bed system that includes a bed frame and a breakaway system. The bed frame includes at least one breakaway member. The breakaway system includes a coupling assembly, signal mechanism, control box and alarm devices. The coupling assembly includes elements that selectably couple a breakaway member to another member of the bed frame. The control box includes a processing unit that, upon sensing a signal from the coupling assembly or signal mechanism that the selectable coupling between the breakaway member and another member of the bed frame is decoupled, provides an indication to an alarm device. The alarm device sends an alert to a user that the selectable coupling between a breakaway member and a member of the bed frame is decoupled.
problem: Alerting a user when a breakaway coupling in a bed system becomes decoupled, since undetected decoupling could compromise safety or functionality.
constraint: Must detect decoupling reliably without false alarms while preserving the mechanical breakaway function that allows the member to separate under force.
mechanism: A detection element monitors mechanical separation of a releasable coupling member and, upon detecting decoupling, triggers an alert through a signal processing chain: separation → detection signal → processing → user notification.
mechanism_raw: A sensor detects mechanical decoupling of the breakaway member and automatically triggers an alarm via a processing unit, creating a causal chain: decoupling → signal → processing → alert.

abstract: A flap door having a soft hinge for a lay-down hunting blind comprises a fabric door frame cover, a door frame receiving pocket formed in the door frame cover, a door frame enclosed within the door frame receiving pocket supporting the door frame cover in planar configuration, the door frame having interconnected U-shaped head end and toe end support members having curved head end and toe end hinge corners supported on the framework of the hunting blind's enclosure, a hinge end of the door frame cover attached to one of two opposing lateral edges of the top opening of the fabric enclosure of the blind without any direct mechanical interconnection between the door frame and the support framework of the enclosure such that a pair of flap doors may be moved between opened and closed configurations over the top opening.
problem: Creating a flap door that can open and close over an opening without rigid mechanical interconnection to the support framework, which would add complexity and wear.
constraint: Must maintain the door frame in a planar configuration and provide adequate support while allowing free movement, all without rigid mechanical connections to the framework.
mechanism: A flexible attachment at one edge of a cover member, combined with passive support from curved contact points of an internal frame resting on a support structure, allows the cover to pivot and translate between open and closed positions without rigid mechanical linkage to the support structure.
mechanism_raw: A flexible/soft hinge attachment at one edge of the door cover, combined with passive support from curved corners of an internal door frame resting on the framework, allows the door to pivot and move between open and closed positions without any direct mechanical linkage to the support structure.

abstract: A tooth brushing system for effectively removing debris and bacteria has an elongated linear handle with a conical flossing brush pivotally located on a handle second end. The system has a tooth brush head with a generally spherical surface with a brush head first side and a brush head second side each having a pair of angular notches and an angular secondary projection linearly located from the brush head top side to the brush head bottom side. A plurality of bristles of a first length is located on a tooth brush head spherical surface. A plurality of bristles of a second length, smaller than the first length, is located on the surfaces of the angular notches, and the angular secondary projections.
problem: Effectively cleaning different tooth surfaces including hard-to-reach areas such as grooves, pits, and interdental spaces that standard bristles cannot access.
constraint: Must balance cleaning effectiveness across diverse tooth geometries while maintaining structural integrity of the brush head and preventing the shorter bristles from being lost in inaccessible areas.
mechanism: A contoured brush head surface with bristles of two different lengths: longer bristles contact broad surfaces while shorter bristles positioned on angular features reach into tight spaces that longer bristles cannot access, providing differential cleaning coverage across diverse geometries.
mechanism_raw: A contoured (spherical) brush head surface with bristles of two different lengths: longer bristles cover broad surfaces while shorter bristles positioned on angular notches and secondary projections reach into tight spaces that longer bristles cannot access, providing differential cleaning coverage.
residual_terms: ["contoured brush head surface", "bristles of two different lengths", "angular features"]

abstract: A curable prepreg or semipreg material comprising a layer of fibers and a substantially non-flowable curable resin having a layer of porous sheet material on an outer surface, the material allows automatic lay-up of high fiber content prepregs or semiprepregs typically used in industrial applications such as wind turbine blades.
problem: Enabling automatic lay-up of high fiber content prepregs or semipregs in industrial applications without the resin flowing excessively and disrupting fiber placement during automated handling.
constraint: Must maintain high fiber content and structural properties of the prepreg while providing sufficient surface interaction characteristics for reliable automated handling without compromising the resin's ability to cure properly.
mechanism: A surface-modifying layer on the outer surface of a fiber-reinforced composite material alters handling characteristics for automated equipment interaction (e.g., vacuum, air flow, surface friction) while a substantially non-flowable curable matrix maintains fiber positioning and prevents unwanted matrix movement during automated placement.
mechanism_raw: A porous sheet material layer on the outer surface of the prepreg modifies the material's handling characteristics for automated equipment interaction (e.g., vacuum, air flow, surface friction) while a substantially non-flowable curable resin maintains fiber positioning and prevents unwanted resin movement during lay-up.

abstract: A method for forming large substantially defect-free void areas on a semiconductor integrated circuit chip includes processing the chip through the passivation level processing operations then forming one or more openings in a designated blank area of the integrated circuit chip in a separate dedicated etching operation. The one or more openings may constitute 5-10% or more of the total area of the semiconductor chip. The void areas are deep trench openings that extend through the passivation layer and through all of the other material layers in the blank area exposing the substrate surface in one embodiment and through all material layers except for a field oxide layer formed directly on the substrate in another embodiment.
problem: Creating large, substantially defect-free void areas on a semiconductor integrated circuit chip without disrupting active circuit regions or introducing defects during normal fabrication processing.
constraint: Must create large voids (5-10% or more of chip area) without defects and without interfering with active circuit areas, requiring the void formation to be isolated to non-critical blank regions through a separate processing step.
mechanism: After completing protective layer processing, a dedicated etching operation creates deep openings in designated non-critical regions of the chip, etching through the protective layer and all underlying material layers to expose the substrate, thereby isolating void formation from the main fabrication flow.
mechanism_raw: After completing passivation-level processing, a separate dedicated etching operation creates deep trench openings in designated blank areas of the chip, etching through the passivation layer and all underlying material layers to expose the substrate, thereby decoupling void formation from the main fabrication flow.
residual_terms: ["protective layer processing", "dedicated etching operation", "deep openings", "non-critical regions"]

abstract: A surgical protective assembly having an air movement device and a head gear assembly carrying the air movement device. The head gear assembly includes an outer wall, an inner wall, a front end, a back end and a middle portion between the front end and the back end. The outer wall has an upper opening, the inner wall has an array of openings, and the inner and outer wall define a front opening at the front end. The head gear assembly has a passageway that fluidly connects together, the upper opening, the array and the front opening.
problem: Providing protective airflow in a confined headgear assembly while maintaining structural integrity and preventing contaminant ingress.
constraint: Balancing sufficient airflow for protection with structural support and minimizing pressure differentials that could compromise the seal or comfort.
mechanism: A network of interconnected pathways within a confined structure directs controlled fluid flow through strategically positioned openings to establish a protective barrier against contaminants while maintaining structural continuity.
mechanism_raw: A multi-layered passageway system that fluidly connects an upper opening, an array of inner wall openings, and a front opening, directing controlled airflow through the headgear to create a protective barrier against contaminants.

abstract: A method of analyzing minerals received within a mining shovel bucket includes collecting data associated with ore received in the bucket, where the bucket includes at least one active sensor, where the ore includes one or more mineral, and where the ore is within a field of the active sensor. The method further includes determining a content of the minerals using the data, transmitting information relating to the content of the minerals to a decision support system, and sorting or processing the ore based on an output of the decision support system. Collecting data associated with the ores may include generating source signals, applying the source signals to the active sensor, collecting a response from the active sensor, and comparing the response with a reference or threshold. Other features are disclosed.
problem: Real-time analysis and sorting of minerals in a mining operation without interrupting the loading or processing workflow.
constraint: Performing analysis and actuation rapidly enough to keep pace with continuous mining operations while maintaining accuracy under variable ore conditions.
mechanism: Sensors emit signals and capture responses from a target medium, compare the responses to predefined thresholds, and trigger actuation decisions through a feedback-driven decision system to enable real-time classification and sorting.
mechanism_raw: Active sensors generate source signals, collect responses from ore within their field, compare responses to thresholds, and trigger sorting/processing decisions via a decision support system based on the analysis.

abstract: There is a method for making. The method includes providing an untreated alkali aluminosilicate glass having an annealing point temperature that is at least about 580° C. The method also includes providing a mixed potassium and sodium salt bath having greater than about 50 mole % potassium salt and less than about 50 mole % sodium salt. The method also includes immersing the untreated glass in the mixed salt bath and maintaining the mixed salt bath with the immersed untreated glass within a temperature range from about 450° C. to less than the annealing point temperature of the untreated glass for a period greater than about 2 hours to produce a strengthened glass. The produced strengthened glass has a surface compression of at least about 100,000 psi and a compression case depth of at least about 600 microns.
problem: Strengthening glass surfaces to achieve high surface compression and deep compression case depth without deforming the glass during treatment.
constraint: Maintaining the bath temperature below the annealing point to prevent deformation while ensuring sufficient ion diffusion time and salt composition to achieve target compression values.
mechanism: A substrate is immersed in a controlled-temperature ionic medium where ion exchange occurs, replacing smaller ions with larger ions in the surface layer to induce compressive stress without exceeding thermal deformation limits.
mechanism_raw: Immersing untreated glass in a mixed potassium/sodium salt bath at a temperature below the glass's annealing point, enabling ion exchange where larger potassium ions replace smaller sodium ions in the surface layer, creating compressive stress.

abstract: An aircraft system and method with a first counterweight rotating balancing rotor mass concentration, and a second counterweight rotating balancing rotor mass concentration to balance a first aircraft propeller. The system includes an inboard electromagnetic coil driver with a first inboard electromagnetic coil, and a second inboard electromagnetic coil, the inboard electromagnetic coil driver and the first counterweight balancing rotor and the second counterweight balancing rotor centered around the aircraft propeller shaft rotating machine member. The system/method utilizes a first control system controller to control the coils and position the mass concentrations to balance the first aircraft propeller. The system/method includes a third counterweight rotating balancing rotor mass concentration, and a fourth counterweight rotating balancing rotor mass concentration to balance a second aircraft propeller which positioned and controlled by a second control system controller.
problem: Dynamically balancing rotating propeller masses in real-time to reduce vibration and mechanical stress during operation.
constraint: Achieving precise, rapid adjustments of counterweight positions in sync with rotational dynamics without introducing additional mechanical complexity or lag.
mechanism: Electromagnetic actuators dynamically reposition distributed mass elements around a rotating axis using real-time feedback to counteract inertial imbalances and reduce vibrational forces during operation.
mechanism_raw: Electromagnetic coil drivers adjust the position of counterweight rotors centered around the propeller shaft, using feedback control to shift mass concentrations and counteract imbalances as the propeller rotates.

abstract: In a gas turbine engine, a fan rotor and a compressor rotor are connected to a joint which is attached to a shaft. The fan rotor is connected to the joint by a plurality of fasteners extending through mounting openings in the joint and through apertures in the fan rotor.
