mechanism_raw: A tank gauge measures ending fuel volume, which is compared to an expected volume. The variance between measured and expected volumes is used to adjust pricing for subsequent transactions, creating a feedback loop for inventory-based pricing.

abstract: The present disclosure provides various systems and methods for indexing digital (electronic) documents. The systems and methods may utilize various software, hardware, and firmware modules to identify notations, such as sheet names, anchors, and anchor references on construction documents. The identified notations are indexed and used to create hyperlinked pages that are easily navigable. In some embodiments, the hyperlinked pages may include previous- and next-sheet hyperlinks that allow for direct navigation within a set of pages, according to an order provided in an index.
problem: Navigating large sets of digital documents (e.g., construction plans) efficiently without manual cross-referencing.
constraint: The system must accurately parse and link notations across documents while maintaining consistent indexing to avoid broken links or navigation errors.
mechanism: Automated parsing identifies and indexes reference elements across multiple documents, generating linked navigation paths based on the index order. Sequential traversal (previous/next) is enabled through hyperlinks derived from the parsed references, eliminating manual cross-referencing.
mechanism_raw: Software identifies notations (sheet names, anchors, references) in documents, indexes them, and generates hyperlinked pages with sequential navigation (previous/next-sheet links) based on the index order.

abstract: Method and apparatus for generating and outputting dynamic variance reports for vehicle operations. The dynamic variance reports enable a vehicle operations scheduler to understand trends, patterns, or the like in variances between planned vehicle operations and actual vehicle operations. The understanding of the variances provided by the dynamic variance reports enable the scheduler to apply buffers to vehicle operations plans so that planned vehicle operations more closely match actual vehicle operations and crew assignments are less likely to be disrupted.
problem: Planned vehicle operations frequently deviate from actual execution, causing inefficiencies and crew disruptions.
constraint: Balancing buffer size to avoid overcompensation while maintaining operational flexibility.
mechanism: Analyzing historical deviations between planned and actual operations to dynamically adjust resource allocations in future plans, creating a feedback loop that aligns scheduling with real-world performance patterns.
mechanism_raw: Analyzing historical variance trends between planned and actual operations to dynamically adjust buffer allocations in future plans, creating a feedback loop that aligns scheduling with real-world performance patterns.

abstract: The method of controlling a rotating three-phase motor involves generating in synchronism with the rotation of the motor a variable duty cycle pulse-width modulated signal for each of the switching circuit components used to supply current to the motor coils. The generated variable duty cycle pulse-width modulated signals control the switching circuit components to selectively place pairs of motor coils in current conducting states and to develop an associated varying voltage for each of the phases. This varying voltage is monitored to identify the one phase that is at a voltage in between the voltages of the other two phases. Then for the identified one phase, the variable duty cycle pulse-width modulated signal is specially generated so that when the switching circuit components of the other two phases are concurrently switched on, the switching circuit component of the identified one phase is not switched on.
problem: Inefficient switching in three-phase motor control systems leads to power loss and suboptimal voltage distribution across phases.
constraint: Maintaining synchronization between phase switching while avoiding overlap-induced inefficiencies.
mechanism: Real-time monitoring of electrical potentials across multiple phases to identify the intermediate-voltage phase, then selectively disabling its activation signal during concurrent activation of the other phases, preventing conflicting current paths and reducing power dissipation.
mechanism_raw: Real-time monitoring of phase voltages to identify the intermediate-voltage phase, then selectively disabling its switching signal during concurrent activation of the other two phases, preventing conflicting current paths and reducing power dissipation.

abstract: Provided is a method for treating keratinous fibers comprising: applying steam to the keratinous fibers at a rate of less than 5 g/min; and shaping the keratinous fibers at a temperature of greater than 50° C., wherein the application of the steam and the shaping of the keratinous fibers do not occur simultaneously. The method disclosed herein may make it possible for example to obtain rapid shaping of the keratinous fibers while improving their cosmetic properties and the comfort of the user.
problem: Simultaneous steam application and shaping of keratinous fibers causes uneven moisture absorption and suboptimal cosmetic results.
constraint: Timing the interval between steam application and shaping to optimize both speed and quality outcomes.
mechanism: Decoupling moisture application and mechanical shaping into sequential steps, allowing materials to absorb moisture first before mechanical shaping, enabling faster processing while preserving material integrity and user comfort.
mechanism_raw: Decoupling steam application and shaping into sequential steps, allowing fibers to absorb moisture first before mechanical shaping, enabling faster processing while preserving material integrity and user comfort.

abstract: The present disclosure provides a device having a doped active region disposed in a substrate. The doped active region having an elongate shape and extends in a first direction. The device also includes a plurality of first metal gates disposed over the active region such that the first metal gates each extend in a second direction different from the first direction. The plurality of first metal gates includes an outer-most first metal gate having a greater dimension measured in the second direction than the rest of the first metal gates. The device further includes a plurality of second metal gates disposed over the substrate but not over the doped active region. The second metal gates contain different materials than the first metal gates. The second metal gates each extend in the second direction and form a plurality of respective N/P boundaries with the first metal gates.
problem: Uniform gate structures in semiconductor devices limit control over charge carrier behavior at N/P boundaries.
constraint: Balancing material compatibility and dimensional gradients to maintain structural integrity while achieving desired electrical characteristics.
mechanism: Using spatially varying gate dimensions and materials to create controlled junctions, where outer gates have larger dimensions and inner gates use different materials, enabling localized modulation of electrical properties.
mechanism_raw: Using spatially varying gate dimensions and materials to create controlled N/P boundaries, where outer gates have larger dimensions and inner gates use different materials, enabling localized modulation of electrical properties.

abstract: A method for fabricating a semiconductor structure and a solid precursor delivery system for a semiconductor fabrication is provided, the method including: providing a solid precursor having a first average particle size; solving the solid precursor in an organic solvent into an intermediate; recrystallizing the intermediate to form solid granules, wherein the solid granules has a second average particle size larger than the first average particle size; vaporizing the solid granules to form a film-forming gas; and depositing the film-forming gas on a substrate to form a resistance film.
problem: Inconsistent particle sizes in solid precursors lead to poor control over vaporization and film uniformity during semiconductor deposition.
constraint: Controlling recrystallization parameters to achieve target particle sizes without introducing impurities or structural defects.
mechanism: Dissolving a solid precursor into an intermediate solution, recrystallizing it into larger granules, and vaporizing the granules to produce a deposition gas, enabling precise control over particle size and material quality.
mechanism_raw: Dissolving a solid precursor into an intermediate solution, recrystallizing it into larger granules, and vaporizing the granules to produce a film-forming gas, enabling precise control over particle size and deposition quality.

abstract: A meat stripper is disclosed for stripping meat from the bone of an animal part. The meat stripper includes a slide block and a first stripper plate assembly including an arm pivotally mounted to the slide block and having a first stripper plate at an opposite end. A second stripper plate assembly including an arm is pivotally mounted to the slide block and has a second stripper plate at an opposite end with the second stripper plate opposing the first stripper plate. The first and second stripper plates move away from each other to open the meat stripper when the arms are pivoted apart and move toward each other to surround the bone when the arms are pivoted together. A mechanism is disclosed for moving the stripper plates along the length of the bone to strip meat from the bone. A mechanism also is disclosed for articulating at least one of the stripper plates after meat has been stripped from the bone in such a way that meat lodged in or on the stripper is dislodged and falls to a collection location below. In one example, the pivot plate pivots to dislodge the meat and is magnetically biased to a stripping position.
problem: Efficiently stripping meat from animal bones while dislodging residual meat lodged on the tool.
constraint: Balancing stripping force against bone integrity while ensuring reliable dislodging of meat without manual intervention.
mechanism: Opposing elements pivot to surround a central object, with a mechanism to translate the elements along the object's length. A separate articulation mechanism pivots at least one element post-stripping to dislodge trapped material, using a biasing element to return the element to its original position.
mechanism_raw: Opposing stripper plates pivot apart to open and together to surround the bone, with a mechanism to translate the plates along the bone's length. A separate articulation mechanism pivots at least one plate post-stripping to dislodge trapped meat, using magnetic biasing to return the plate to its stripping position.

abstract: A one-handed paddle for use in pairs with paddleboards, each paddle comprising a longitudinal main shaft, an axial ski pole type grip on the upper end of the shaft and aligned with the shaft axis, an elongated elastic wrist/arm strap on an upper surface of the shaft near the grip defining a tunnel for the arm generally parallel to the shaft in an unstretched condition, and a blade on the lower end of the shaft, the blade set at an acute upward angle to the main axis of the shaft. The blade has an inverted, rounded L-shape, with an inwardly-facing upper shoulder extending inwardly above and beyond a lower inner edge of the blade, the shoulder configured to ride along the upper surface of a paddleboard during the push portion of a paddling stroke.
problem: Enabling effective paddling with a single hand while maintaining control and leverage during the stroke.
constraint: Maintaining ergonomic control and mechanical advantage with one hand while minimizing slippage or loss of coordination.
mechanism: An axial grip aligned with the shaft, combined with an elastic stabilizing strap forming a parallel tunnel, allows one-handed control. The blade's geometry converts downward force into forward propulsion by riding along a surface during the push phase.
mechanism_raw: An axial grip aligned with the shaft, combined with an elastic wrist/arm strap forming a parallel tunnel, allows one-handed stabilization. The blade's inverted L-shape and inward shoulder ride along the paddleboard's upper surface during the push phase, converting downward force into forward propulsion.

abstract: An exemplary elongated elevator load bearing member of a traction elevator system includes a plurality of tension elements. A plurality of weave fibers transverse to the tension elements are woven with the tension elements. The weave fibers define at least one traction surface of the load bearing member.
problem: Creating a durable, high-traction load-bearing member for elevator systems that balances strength and friction.
constraint: Optimizing fiber orientation and material selection to maximize tensile strength without compromising traction performance.
mechanism: A composite structure integrates transverse fibers with longitudinal tension elements, where the transverse fibers define a traction surface. This arrangement distributes load while providing controlled friction for engagement.
mechanism_raw: Transverse weave fibers are integrated with longitudinal tension elements, forming a composite structure where the weave fibers define the traction surface. This arrangement distributes load while providing controlled surface friction for belt-pulley engagement.
residual_terms: ["transverse weave fibers", "longitudinal tension elements", "composite structure", "traction surface"]

abstract: Focused libraries of vectors or genetic packages that display, display and express, or comprise a member of a diverse family of antibody peptides, polypeptides or proteins and collectively display, display and express, or comprise at least a portion of the focused diversity of the family. The libraries have length and sequence diversities that mimic that found in native human antibodies.
problem: Generating diverse antibody libraries that mimic natural human antibody diversity for therapeutic or research applications.
constraint: Balancing library diversity with functional expression efficiency to ensure viable candidates emerge from the selection process.
mechanism: Vectors display a family of antibody peptides with engineered sequence and length diversities to replicate native variability. This focused diversity enables broad molecular interactions while targeting specific regions.
mechanism_raw: Vectors or genetic packages display a family of antibody peptides/proteins with sequence and length diversities engineered to replicate native human antibody variability. This focused diversity enables broad molecular interaction while targeting specific antigenic regions.
residual_terms: ["vectors or genetic packages", "antibody peptides/proteins", "sequence and length diversities", "antigenic regions"]

abstract: A process for quenching heat treated metal parts using a liquid quenchant and high pressure is disclosed. In general, the process includes the steps of providing a load of heat treated metal parts in a pressure vessel wherein the load is at an elevated temperature after being heat treated. In a subsequent step, a liquid quenchant is injected into the pressure vessel such that a vapor of the liquid quenchant forms rapidly in the pressure vessel and cools the metal parts. The step of injecting the liquid quenchant into the pressure vessel is continued for a time sufficient to establish a desired peak vapor pressure in the pressure vessel. An apparatus for carrying out the disclosed process is also described.
problem: Rapidly and uniformly quenching heat-treated metal parts to achieve desired material properties without thermal distortion.
constraint: Controlling vapor pressure dynamics to prevent uneven cooling or part damage while achieving sufficient heat transfer efficiency.
mechanism: High-pressure injection of liquid quenchant into a vessel creates rapid vapor formation, cooling parts through controlled vapor-phase heat transfer until a target vapor pressure is reached.
mechanism_raw: High-pressure injection of liquid quenchant into a pressure vessel creates rapid vapor formation, which cools the metal parts through controlled vapor-phase heat transfer. The process continues until a target peak vapor pressure is reached, ensuring consistent cooling rates.
residual_terms: ["pressure vessel", "liquid quenchant", "vapor-phase heat transfer", "peak vapor pressure"]

abstract: A mounting device for coaxially anchoring a machine element upon a rotary shaft is provided. The device fits between the interior bore of the machine element and the cylindrical surface of the shaft and is effective to position the element at any desired position longitudinally of the shaft and at any angular position circumferentially of the shaft. The device has inner and outer sleeves, the mating surfaces of which are similarly tapered so that relative axial displacement of the sleeves affects expansion and contraction of the interior bore and external surface of the combined elements. Rotation of a threaded nut at one end of the device effects the relative axial displacement of the inner and outer sleeves to afford expansion and contraction of the sleeves without excessively straining the material of the sleeves or the nut.
problem: Precisely positioning a machine element on a rotary shaft both longitudinally and circumferentially without excessive material strain.
constraint: Balancing positional precision with material stress limits to avoid deformation or failure of the sleeves or nut.
mechanism: A coaxial dual-taper interface converts axial displacement into controlled radial deformation, enabling simultaneous longitudinal and circumferential positioning while distributing mechanical strain across the engaged material.
mechanism_raw: Tapered inner and outer sleeves convert axial displacement (via a threaded nut) into radial expansion/contraction, enabling positional adjustment while distributing strain across the material.

abstract: An apparatus, device, or method may detect aim or pointing direction of a firearm, and may display aim directions of the firearm for gunshots fired at a target. Sequence of bullet strikes by multiple gunshots may be determined. A method may comprise detecting gunshots of the firearm discharging live ammunition, measuring aim directions of the firearm substantially at times of detecting the gunshots, recording the times of the gunshots and/or sequence order of the gunshots, and generating output for displaying an image that includes bullet strike icons that represent bullet strikes on the target. Locations of the bullet strike icons in the image may be based, at least in part, on the measured aim directions of the gunshots.
problem: Tracking and visualizing the aim direction and sequence of gunshots fired at a target in real time.
constraint: Ensuring real-time synchronization between shot detection, aim measurement, and visual output accuracy.
mechanism: Discharge sensors capture projectile launch events and directional orientation, then correlate these measurements to impact locations on a displayed target surface in real time.
mechanism_raw: Sensors detect gunshots and measure firearm aim direction at the time of discharge, then map these measurements to bullet strike icons on a displayed target image.

abstract: An automatic transmission is provided with a frictional engagement member that is operated by hydraulic pressure for shifting the automatic transmission, and includes an air vent opening. An automatic transmission controller includes a pressure regulator and a control section. The pressure regulator regulates the hydraulic pressure in response to a hydraulic pressure control signal. The control section performs an air vent operation of venting air from the frictional engagement member through the air vent opening. The air vent operation includes: a preliminary operation of setting the hydraulic pressure control signal to a preliminary pulse indicative of a preliminary value of pressure, wherein the preliminary value is lower than a normal value of pressure; and a normal operation of setting the hydraulic pressure control signal to a normal pulse indicative of the normal value, wherein the normal pulse follows the preliminary pulse.
problem: Efficiently venting air from a hydraulic frictional engagement member during pressure regulation in an automatic transmission.
constraint: Preventing over-pressurization during air venting while ensuring complete air expulsion before normal operation.
mechanism: A staged pressure control sequence applies a preliminary low-pressure phase to expel trapped gas, followed by a normal-pressure phase to establish full engagement of the frictional element.
mechanism_raw: A two-step hydraulic pressure control signal: a preliminary low-pressure pulse to vent air, followed by a normal-pressure pulse to engage the frictional member.

abstract: Systems for enhanced head-to-head hybrid gaming are provided. A network distributed enhanced head-to-head hybrid game system has a real world server connected to a game world engine by a network, wherein the real world server is constructed to: receive from the game world server via the network, a trigger of a wager of an amount of real world credits; and provide a randomly generated payout of real world credits for the wager of the amount of real world credits wherein the result is determined using a random number generator; a controller connected to the game world server by the network, wherein the controller is constructed to: provide an entertainment game; generate a display of the entertainment game; and convey to the game world server, actions taken by the player during the player's skillful execution of the entertainment game while utilizing the resource of the entertainment game; and the game world server connected by the network to the real world server and connected to the controller, wherein the game world server is constructed to: receive the actions taken by the player; determine player performance measurements for the player based on the actions taken by the player; convey to the real world server via the network, the trigger of the wager of the amount of real world credit based on the actions taken by the player; determine eligibility of the player for head-to-head of the entertainment game of the controller; assign a handicap for the head-to-head play to the player based upon the player performance measurements for the player, wherein the handicap is a random element introduced into a game world of the player during the head-to-head play, and wherein the handicap is based upon a ratio of game world credit earned as an outcome of the player's skillful execution of the entertainment game and the amount of real world credits utilized by the player in the wager as triggered by the real world server upon the player's utilization of the resource during the player's skillful execution of the entertainment game while earning the game world credit; and introduce the random element of the handicap into the game world of the player during the head-to-head play.
problem: Balancing skill-based and chance-based elements in head-to-head hybrid gaming to maintain fairness and engagement.
constraint: Maintaining a balance between skill and randomness to ensure fair competition while preserving player engagement.
mechanism: Performance-based metrics dynamically modulate a randomized adjustment applied to game conditions, balancing deterministic skill outcomes with stochastic variability during competitive play.
mechanism_raw: Player performance metrics (e.g., game credit earned vs. real-world credits wagered) dynamically determine a random handicap applied to the game world during head-to-head play.

abstract: A hand exercise device comprising a base with a generally planar surface, and at least one string held at a substantial angle of inclination with respect to the planar surface of the base. The hand exercise device can be adapted to perform hand exercises that involve applying a pushing force to move the string such that the string is in contact with the planar surface of the base. The hand exercise device can be modified to include a plurality of strings of different thicknesses held at a substantial angle of inclination to facilitate variable exercise resistance. The hand exercise device can benefit patients by increasing grip strength, improving hand function, and/or alleviating joint pain.
problem: Providing variable resistance for hand exercises to improve grip strength and joint function.
constraint: Achieving adjustable resistance through simple mechanical geometry without complex mechanisms.
mechanism: Elastomeric elements of varying compliance are progressively compressed against a rigid surface, with resistance increasing as compression depth increases.
mechanism_raw: Inclined strings of varying thickness are pressed against a planar base surface, with resistance increasing as the string is pushed into contact with the base.

abstract: Provided is a manufacturing method of a three-dimensional structure which manufactures a three-dimensional structure by laminating layers, the method including: forming the layers using a three-dimensional formation composition containing three-dimensional formation powders, a solvent, and a binder; discharging a binding solution containing a binding agent to the layers; and performing a permeation prevention step of preventing the solvent from permeating the layers, at least on a part of the layers to which the binding solution is discharged. It is preferable that the permeation prevention process is selectively performed with respect to an area of the layers to which the binding solution is not discharged.
problem: Controlling solvent distribution in layered manufacturing to prevent unintended spreading and ensure localized binder effectiveness.
constraint: Balancing solvent retention in targeted areas while allowing permeation in regions where binding solution is discharged, ensuring uniform layer formation without compromising structural cohesion.
mechanism: A selective barrier mechanism restricts solvent migration in targeted regions of layered structures where binder application is absent, maintaining spatial integrity by preventing cross-contamination between adjacent zones during material deposition.
mechanism_raw: Selective permeation prevention of solvent in specific regions of the layers, where binding solution is not applied, to maintain structural integrity and prevent solvent migration into areas requiring precise binder placement.

abstract: An alignment assembly that automatically aligns the inverted ball socket on a trailer tongue and temporarily raises the ball socket over a ball mounted on the end of the towing vehicle as the towing vehicle is being backed up. The assembly includes a tongue mount attached to the front edge of the ball socket on a trailer. The tongue mount includes a vertical, transversely aligned front plate in front of the ball socket. Selectively attached to the front plate is a vertical sliding transverse plate that attaches to a forward extending, diagonally aligned guide tunnel. The guide tunnel includes a wide front opening and narrow rear opening that terminates directly in front of the ball socket. During use, the ball travels rearward into the guide funnel which creates a lifting force on the guide funnel. Upward force on the guide funnel causes the trailer tongue to lift. When the ball clears the guide tunnel, the ball socket falls and is aligned with the ball.
problem: Automatically aligning a trailer ball socket with a towing vehicle's ball during reverse backing without manual intervention.
constraint: Geometric design of the guide tunnel and sliding transverse plate must ensure smooth ball entry, controlled lifting, and precise alignment without jamming or misalignment during dynamic backing motion.
mechanism: A tapered guide structure with variable cross-sectional geometry interacts with a moving spherical element to generate a controlled lifting force during insertion, followed by a release phase that enables precise alignment through gravitational settling once the element clears the structure.
mechanism_raw: A guide tunnel with a wide front opening and narrow rear opening interacts with the ball's movement, creating a lifting force on the trailer tongue as the ball enters the tunnel, then allowing the socket to drop into alignment once the ball clears the tunnel.

abstract: A brace for a wall-mounted toilet, particularly useful for wall-mounted porcelain toilets in hospitals and other health care facilities. The brace includes a weight receiving structure supported by cantilevered struts that attach the brace to the wall, preferably using the same bolts that attach the toilet to the wall. The weight receiving structure may be a seat portion that overlies the rim of the toilet bowl, so that the weight of the user is transmitted from the toilet seat to the seat structure and then to the walls through the struts. Alternately, the weight receiving structure may include an under-bowl support that extends underneath the toilet bowl so that the user's weight is transmitted from the bowl to the wall through the struts. Thus, the cantilevered brace increases the weight-bearing capacity of the wall-mounted toilet. A plastic shroud may be included for enclosing the brace and toilet bowl.
problem: Increasing the weight-bearing capacity of wall-mounted toilets in healthcare settings to safely support user loads.
constraint: Structural integration with existing toilet mounting hardware and wall attachment points while maintaining compatibility with porcelain fixtures and minimizing visible hardware.
mechanism: Load-transfer struts extend from a fixture interface to a structural mounting point, distributing applied forces across a broader support area through existing attachment hardware rather than relying on localized fixture strength.
mechanism_raw: Cantilevered struts transfer user weight from the toilet seat or bowl through a weight-receiving structure to the wall via existing mounting bolts, distributing load across the wall structure rather than relying solely on the toilet's attachment points.

abstract: A desiccant air conditioning system for treating an air stream entering a building space, including a conditioner configured to expose the air stream to a liquid desiccant such that the liquid desiccant dehumidifies the air stream in the warm weather operation mode and humidifies the air stream in the cold weather operation mode. The conditioner includes multiple plate structures arranged in a vertical orientation and spaced apart to permit the air stream to flow between the plate structures. Each plate structure includes a passage through which a heat transfer fluid can flow. Each plate structure also has at least one surface across which the liquid desiccant can flow. The system includes a regenerator connected to the conditioner for causing the liquid desiccant to desorb water in the warm weather operation mode and to absorb water in the cold weather operation mode from a return air stream.
problem: Efficiently dehumidifying or humidifying an air stream in a building space using a desiccant system with minimal energy consumption.
constraint: Maintaining optimal contact time between air and desiccant surfaces while balancing heat transfer fluid flow rates to ensure consistent performance across varying temperature and humidity conditions.
mechanism: Counterflow heat and mass exchange occurs between an air stream and a moisture-adsorbing surface integrated with fluid-carrying channels, while a regenerative energy recovery loop transfers thermal energy between opposing airflow directions to minimize external energy input.
mechanism_raw: Vertical plate structures with desiccant-coated surfaces and heat transfer fluid passages enable counterflow heat and mass exchange between the air stream and desiccant, while a regenerator recovers energy by desorbing or absorbing moisture from a return air stream.

abstract: An assembly for undermounting a sink to a support surface includes a central sink support supporting a front center portion of a sink. The central sink support includes an elongated block member having an upper surface, a lower surface and extending sidewalls. The central sink support also includes first and second screw holes shaped and dimensioned for the passage of screws that will be secured to a front wall of a sink cabinet and a threaded locking pin hole with a similarly threaded locking screw. The assembly also includes a mounting driver having a support bar shaped and dimensioned for positioning between an underside of the sink and a wall of a cabinet at an angular orientation relative to the wall. The support bar includes a first end and a second end.
problem: Securely undermounting a sink to a support surface (e.g., cabinet) with adjustable positioning and minimal visible hardware.
constraint: Achieving angular orientation compatibility between the support bar and cabinet wall while ensuring screw and locking pin engagement without interfering with the sink's structural integrity or cabinet aesthetics.
mechanism: An elongated adjustment interface with angular orientation compatibility enables precise positioning of a fixture relative to a support surface through a combination of translational sliding and rotational locking mechanisms, distributing installation forces across multiple engagement points.
mechanism_raw: An elongated central support block with screw holes and a threaded locking pin hole interfaces with a mounting driver featuring an angular support bar positioned between the sink and cabinet wall, enabling precise alignment and load distribution during installation.

abstract: The present utility model relates to a vacuum breaker, an automatic flushing system for toilet having the vacuum breaker, and an electric bidet toilet having the automatic flushing system for toilet. The vacuum breaker comprises a body and a cover which cooperate to define a cavity, the body being integrally formed with an inlet pipe section which defines a water inlet and an outlet pipe section which defines a water outlet, the cover being formed with an air port, wherein a tip portion of the inlet pipe section extends into the cavity in a direction towards the air port. The length of the tip portion of the inlet pipe section which extends within the cavity is greater than half of the height of the cavity. According to the present utility model, because the tip portion of the inlet pipe section extends almost throughout the cavity of the vacuum breaker, the level of the water inlet is elevated, so that the CL (critical level) line is raised.
problem: Preventing backflow or contamination in a vacuum breaker system by maintaining a critical water level barrier.
constraint: Balancing the tip length to ensure sufficient CL elevation without compromising structural integrity or flow efficiency.
mechanism: Positioning a fluid inlet component within a containment cavity such that the inlet's placement elevates a liquid level, creating a self-sustaining barrier that passively prevents reverse flow or intrusion of contaminants.
mechanism_raw: Extending the inlet pipe tip nearly the full cavity length elevates the water inlet level, raising the critical level (CL) line to act as a passive barrier against backflow.

abstract: Systems, methods, and apparatus are disclosed for generating power for a vehicle. Apparatus may include a power generator configured to generate power based on one or more aerodynamic forces associated with a vehicle. The power generator may be further configured to be deployed from a first portion of the vehicle. The apparatus may also include a flow control device configured to generate an increase in airflow associated with the power generator. The increase in airflow enables, at least in part, the generation of additional power by the power generator. The flow control device may be further configured to be deployed from a second portion of the vehicle.
problem: Generating additional power from aerodynamic forces on a vehicle while minimizing energy loss.
constraint: Optimizing deployment positioning and timing to maximize airflow enhancement without disrupting vehicle aerodynamics or operation.
mechanism: Deploying a dynamically adjustable flow-modifying structure to augment aerodynamic interaction with a power generation element, thereby amplifying energy extraction from ambient airflow.
mechanism_raw: Deploying a flow control device to increase airflow over a power generator, amplifying aerodynamic forces to boost power output.

abstract: Provided is a fluid control valve assembly including: a main valve body having a first flow passage that is mounted on an inlet of a high-pressure vessel and through which a charging source gas passes, a second flow passage through which a feeding source gas passes, and a third flow passage to which the first flow passage and the second flow passage are connected; a manual valve that is mounted on the main valve body and that opens and closes the third flow passage; a solenoid valve that is mounted on the main valve body and that opens and closes the second flow passage by an electrical signal; a first check valve that is provided on the first flow passage to thus block a reverse flow of the charging source gas; and a second check valve that is provided on the second flow passage to thus block a reverse flow of the feeding source gas, and block the charging source gas from flowing in the second flow passage, to thereby prevent the charging source gas from flowing in the solenoid valve. Accordingly, a charging gas pressure of a high-pressure is prevented from being applied to a solenoid valve, to thereby prevent damage to the solenoid valve and to prevent a malfunction of the solenoid valve.
problem: Protecting a solenoid valve from high-pressure gas damage in a fluid control system.
constraint: Ensuring check valve response time and sealing integrity under varying pressure conditions to maintain isolation.
mechanism: Integrating redundant unidirectional flow-blocking elements on parallel pathways to isolate a sensitive control component from pressure surges, ensuring reverse-flow prevention and pressure decoupling.
mechanism_raw: Using check valves on parallel flow paths to block reverse flow and isolate the solenoid valve from high-pressure charging gas, preventing pressure-induced damage.

abstract: A method includes recording, at an electronic device utilizing a microphone of the electronic device, ambient noise of an environment the electronic device is disposed in; electronically analyzing, utilizing one or more processors, the recorded ambient noise of the environment to determine one or more frequency bands to avoid; dynamically adapting, based on the electronic analysis, an auditory alert to be played at the electronic device, such adaptation including frequency equalization adjustments based on the determination of one or more frequency bands to avoid; and playing, at the electronic device utilizing one or more speakers of the electronic device, the adapted auditory alert.
problem: Ensuring an auditory alert remains perceptible in environments with variable ambient noise.
constraint: Achieving real-time processing speed and accuracy to adapt the alert without perceptible delay.
mechanism: Continuously analyzing ambient acoustic conditions and adaptively modifying alert signal characteristics to maintain perceptual separation from dominant noise interference.
mechanism_raw: Analyzing ambient noise frequencies in real-time and dynamically adjusting the alert's frequency equalization to avoid masking by dominant noise bands.

abstract: A method of remediating contaminated sediment area. The sediment has an initial water depth and comprises water and fine-grained solids. The contaminated sediment is contained in place by installing over the contaminated sediment an in-situ cap having a total thickness TCP. The contaminated sediment, and optionally any uncontaminated subsurface, is then consolidated until the total settlement of the contaminated and uncontaminated sediment exceeds the thickness TCP of the in-situ cap. The sediment is consolidated by installing a vertical barrier along the perimeter of the contaminated sediment area, installing a plurality of horizontal line drains into the sediment, connecting the horizontal line drains to a vacuum source, installing an in-situ cap over the contaminated sediment area and over the upper edge of the vertical barrier, and applying vacuum pressure to the horizontal line drains to dewater and consolidate the sediment.
problem: Stabilizing and containing contaminated sediment in situ while minimizing environmental disturbance.
constraint: Matching cap thickness to predicted settlement volume to ensure long-term containment without structural failure.
mechanism: Applying vacuum-assisted consolidation through distributed extraction points to densify particulate deposits, followed by enclosing the treated area with a perimeter containment structure and overlying seal to prevent environmental dispersion.
mechanism_raw: Applying vacuum-induced dewatering via horizontal drains to consolidate sediment, combined with a perimeter barrier and cap to contain settled material.

abstract: Inspection processing is performed. The inspection processing includes a first driving step of driving a piezoelectric element corresponding to an inspection target nozzle, a first detection step of detecting vibration that is generated in ink in a pressure chamber corresponding to the inspection target nozzle by the driving in the first driving step, a second driving step of driving together the piezoelectric element corresponding to the inspection target nozzle and a piezoelectric element corresponding to at least one nozzle of nozzles adjacent to the inspection target nozzle, and a second detection step of detecting vibration that is generated in the ink in the pressure chamber corresponding to the inspection target nozzle by the driving in the second driving step.
problem: Accurately inspecting individual nozzles in an inkjet system for defects while accounting for interactions between adjacent nozzles.
constraint: Balancing the need for individual nozzle inspection with the physical coupling between adjacent nozzles, which can mask or amplify defects if not properly isolated or analyzed.
mechanism: Actuating a target element in isolation and then actuating it together with adjacent elements, then comparing the resulting response signals to identify defects or interaction effects caused by coupling between elements.
mechanism_raw: Driving a piezoelectric element for a target nozzle and detecting its vibration, then driving the target nozzle together with adjacent nozzles and detecting vibration again. The comparison between isolated and coupled vibration responses identifies defects or cross-talk effects caused by nozzle interactions.

abstract: The invention relates to a fabric filter system, having a first fabric filtering device in the form of elongated tubular fabric bag; a first gas tank for providing compressed gas; a first pulsing gas duct fluidly connected between the first fabric filtering device and the first gas tank through a first pulsing valve for cleaning the first fabric filtering device. The fabric filter system further includes a second gas tank for providing compressed gas. The second gas tank is fluidly connected with the first gas tank through a control valve. The first pulsing valve is opened to introduce the compressed gas into the first filtering device for cleaning when the control valve remains open. The control valve is closed after a predetermined time. A method for cleaning the fabric filter system is disclosed.
problem: Efficiently cleaning fabric filters in a gas filtration system using compressed gas pulses while managing pressure and timing to avoid overconsumption of gas.
constraint: Timing the control valve closure to ensure sufficient cleaning while preventing excessive gas usage or pressure imbalances between the two tanks.
mechanism: Using two reservoirs connected by a controllable valve. A pulsing mechanism introduces pressurized fluid from the first reservoir to perform a cleaning action while the valve is open. After a predetermined duration, the valve closes to isolate the reservoirs, terminating the cleaning cycle and enabling staged pressure management.
mechanism_raw: Using two gas tanks connected via a control valve. When the control valve is open, a pulsing valve introduces compressed gas from the first tank to clean the filter. After a predetermined time, the control valve closes, isolating the tanks and ending the cleaning cycle. This allows sequential or staged cleaning with controlled pressure release.

abstract: A process of producing shell and tube heat exchangers where the ends of the tubes are secured to a tube sheet while reacting applied FSW forces without introducing a crevice or local deformation near the ends of the tubes. In particular, an interference fit is used to lock the ends of the tubes into the tube sheet without flaring or expanding the tube ends. A FSW process is then used to weld the ends of the tubes to the tube sheet.
problem: Securing tubes to a tube sheet in heat exchangers without introducing crevices or local deformation that could compromise structural integrity or promote corrosion.
constraint: Achieving a precise interference fit that holds tubes securely without inducing stress concentrations, while ensuring FSW parameters do not disrupt the mechanical lock or damage the tube ends.
mechanism: Creating a mechanical interference between a tube end and apertured plate to pre-align and stabilize the tube without external deformation, then applying localized plastic deformation via a moving tool to join the stabilized interface, eliminating gaps that could form crevices.
mechanism_raw: Using an interference fit to mechanically lock tube ends into the tube sheet without flaring or expanding them, then applying friction stir welding (FSW) to weld the locked ends. The interference fit pre-aligns and stabilizes the tubes during welding, eliminating gaps that could form crevices.

abstract: An interface component for engaging an arrow tip to the leading end of an arrow shaft. The device directs impact forces axially and eliminates the shearing and wall collapse of arrow shafts caused by conventional collared arrow head engagement devices which tend to collapse and cut the leading edge of arrow shafts on hard impacts. Engagement to the arrow shaft leading end is provided by an elongated member axially engaged with the bore of the arrow shaft. The exterior surface of the device can be surfaced to interact with passing air during flight of the arrow and increase spin for better accuracy.
problem: Preventing shearing and wall collapse of arrow shafts during high-impact collisions while maintaining flight stability and accuracy.
constraint: Balancing axial force distribution to prevent structural failure with aerodynamic shaping that enhances spin without adding excessive drag or weight.
mechanism: Inserting an elongated internal member into a hollow shaft to redirect impact forces along the shaft's axis, distributing stress and preventing localized failure. An external surface geometry interacts with fluid flow to induce rotational motion for enhanced stability.
mechanism_raw: An elongated member inserted into the arrow shaft's bore directs impact forces axially along the shaft, distributing stress and preventing localized shearing. The exterior surface is shaped to interact with airflow, inducing spin for improved accuracy.

abstract: Seed index system and methods for treating agricultural seeds with one or more seed care products employing a size-adjusted application rate based on the size of the seeds. Such size-adjusted application rates can be determined by a supplier of seed care products and communicated to an applicator who applies the seed care product to a quantity of seeds. Such size-adjusted application rates can be in the form of a chart, an equation, or a calculator.
problem: Applying seed care products to agricultural seeds in quantities optimized for seed size to ensure efficacy without waste.
constraint: Accurately correlating seed size to optimal dosage while maintaining scalability and consistency across varying seed batches and application equipment.
mechanism: Determining a dosage amount based on a measured physical characteristic of a target item using a predefined mapping function, then scaling the application of a treatment substance proportionally to the determined dosage during processing.
mechanism_raw: Determining application rates based on seed size using a pre-defined chart, equation, or calculator. The size-adjusted rate is communicated to an applicator, which scales the product dosage proportionally to the seed size during treatment.

abstract: Disclosed is a method for enabling cross platform persistent gaming sessions using a mobile device in a system that includes a game server, a network, one or more gaming machines, and one or more mobile devices. The method includes: associating a player's mobile device with one of the one or more gaming machines at which the player has a gaming session; presenting a player with an option to move their gaming experience to their mobile device when the player leaves the associated gaming machine if a gaming session is in progress; enabling the player to use its mobile device to continue playing a game after the player has left a proximity of the associated gaming machine by transferring the game from the associated gaming machine to the player's mobile device; and enabling transfer of funds between the associated gaming machine and the players' mobile device.
problem: Maintaining continuity of a user's interactive session (e.g., gaming) when transitioning between physical locations or devices.
constraint: Ensuring real-time synchronization of session data and funds between devices without loss of state or security breaches during the transfer.
mechanism: Detect a user's transition between physical locations or devices and automatically transfer active session state (including progress, resources, and control) between devices in real-time, preserving continuity of interaction without interrupting ongoing activities or compromising data integrity.
mechanism_raw: Automatically transferring the active session state (game progress, funds, and control) from a primary device to a mobile device upon detecting the user's departure, enabling seamless continuation of the session on the mobile device.

abstract: In accordance with some embodiments, a plurality of outcomes are generated and used to create a video presentation of representative outcomes. The video presentation is recorded onto a tangible medium (e.g., DVD or CD-ROM) or otherwise provided to a player (e.g., player may access the video presentation online). This allows a player to purchase a video presentation of (e.g., predetermined) outcomes in a jurisdiction in which gambling is legal yet view the presentation at the player's convenience (e.g., from any jurisdiction and at any time). The outcomes on the DVD or CD ROM may be viewed on a video display generated by a primary output device (e.g., a personal computer or a DVD player). In addition, the player may purchase or otherwise obtain an accessory device that interacts (e.g., augments the outcomes) with the game play recorded on the tangible medium.
problem: Allowing users to purchase or access gambling outcomes in one jurisdiction while viewing or interacting with them in another jurisdiction where such activities may be restricted.
constraint: Balancing legal compliance across jurisdictions while maintaining the integrity and interactivity of the pre-recorded outcomes.
mechanism: Decouple the creation or acquisition of outcomes from their consumption by pre-recording or pre-generating outcomes on a medium, enabling interaction with the outcomes through a separate accessory device to modify or augment the recorded results, while maintaining legal compliance across jurisdictions.
mechanism_raw: Pre-recording outcomes onto a tangible medium (e.g., DVD) or providing them digitally, decoupling the purchase/creation of outcomes from their consumption, and enabling interaction via an accessory device to augment the recorded outcomes.

abstract: Provided is a printed circuit board, including: a circuit pattern or a base pattern formed on an insulating layer; and a plurality of metal layers formed on the circuit pattern or the base pattern, wherein the metal layers includes: a silver metal layer formed of a metal material including silver; a first palladium metal layer formed at a lower part of the silver metal layer; and a second palladium metal layer formed at an upper part of the silver metal layer.
reason: The mechanism is a specific material arrangement (silver and palladium layers) for PCB conductivity/durability, which is a product-specific solution rather than a generalizable causal principle.

abstract: A guide tube pitch adjustment apparatus for aligning distal ends of lance guide tubes in registry with tube openings in a heat exchanger tube sheet is disclosed. A guide tube pitch clamp assembly carried within and supported from a housing. The pitch clamp assembly has at least two V-blocks fastened to a threaded rod. One V-block is fastened to a portion of the threaded rod having right hand threads, and another V-block is fastened to another portion of the threaded rod having left hand threads. Each of the V-blocks supports a portion of one of the guide tubes, and a cross bar clamp within the housing is oriented to span across the V-blocks and adjustably hold the portions of the guide tubes in a spaced relationship such that spacing between the distal ends of adjacent guide tubes may be adjusted by rotation of the threaded rod.
problem: Precisely aligning multiple components (e.g., guide tubes) in a mechanical system to ensure their distal ends are registered with corresponding openings in a fixed structure (e.g., a tube sheet).
constraint: Achieving synchronized bidirectional movement of multiple components with a single actuation mechanism while maintaining structural stability.
mechanism: Use a single rotational input to drive opposing mechanical elements with complementary directional motion (e.g., via opposing thread directions) to synchronize bidirectional adjustment of multiple components, ensuring simultaneous alignment of their distal ends with corresponding openings in a fixed structure.
mechanism_raw: Using a threaded rod with opposing thread directions (right-hand and left-hand) to drive V-blocks in opposite directions, enabling simultaneous adjustment of spacing between adjacent components via a single rotational input.

abstract: A water soluble liquid fertilizer concentrate is provided that includes a bio-available phosphorus source, said phosphorus source consisting essentially of a phosphite salt. At least one of a bio-available nitrogen source and a bio-available potassium source are also provided. At least one micronutrient of calcium, magnesium, cobalt, iron, manganese, copper, boron, zinc, or molybdenum is present in the concentrate as an aqueous solute or soluble chelates. In some embodiments, the at least one phosphite salt is present at between 30 to 57 total weight percent dissolved in water and optionally contains a phosphate salt. A process of fertilizing a crop includes diluting the fertilizer concentrate with water to obtain a liquid fertilizer solution. The liquid fertilizer solution is then applied to the crop and after by allowing sufficient time, the fertilizer solution promotes growth of the crop.
problem: Delivering a concentrated, stable, and bio-available nutrient formulation that is easily transportable and dissolvable in water for agricultural use.
constraint: Balancing nutrient solubility, concentration, and chelation efficiency to ensure effective delivery without precipitation or degradation during storage or application.
mechanism: Formulate a concentrated, water-soluble composition using phosphite-based compounds and chelated micronutrients to enhance solubility, chemical stability, and bioavailability, enabling dilution and application as a liquid delivery system without precipitation or degradation during storage or use.
mechanism_raw: Formulating a water-soluble concentrate using phosphite salts (for phosphorus) and chelated micronutrients to enhance solubility, stability, and bio-availability, allowing dilution and application as a liquid fertilizer.

abstract: An engine control system for a construction machine is disclosed, which can compulsorily stop engine driving when an attachment or the like malfunctions against an operator's intention during the operation of an excavator or the like. The engine control system includes a first step of determining whether pilot signal pressure, which is detected when at least one of an operation lever and a traveling pedal for respectively operating an attachment, a swing device, and a traveling device is operated, exceeds a first set pressure, and a second step of determining whether the pressure on the outlet side of a main hydraulic pump exceeds a second set pressure, wherein if the pilot signal pressure detected in the first step does not exceed the first pressure and the pressure of the main hydraulic pump detected in the second step exceeds the second pressure, engine driving is compulsorily stopped by means of a control signal from the controller.
problem: Preventing unintended engine operation in construction machinery due to malfunctions in attachments or hydraulic systems.
constraint: Balancing sensitivity to malfunctions without false positives caused by normal operational pressure fluctuations.
mechanism: Dual-signal comparison with conditional shutdown: A controller monitors two pressure indicators—one representing intentional input and another representing system activity. When the input signal falls below a first threshold while the activity signal exceeds a second threshold, the controller triggers a shutdown to prevent unintended operation.
mechanism_raw: Dual-pressure monitoring: A controller compares pilot signal pressure (operator input) and main hydraulic pump outlet pressure. If the pilot signal is below a threshold (indicating no intentional input) while the pump pressure exceeds a threshold (indicating unintended hydraulic activity), the controller triggers an engine shutdown.

abstract: A plasmonic light source includes a substrate and a square nano-cavity formed on the substrate. The nano-cavity includes a quantum well structure. The quantum well structure includes III-V materials. A plasmonic metal is formed as an electrode on the square nano-cavity and is configured to excite surface plasmons with the quantum well structure to generate light. Complementary metal oxide semiconductor (CMOS) devices are formed on the substrate.
problem: Efficient light generation in integrated optoelectronic systems, particularly for compatibility with CMOS devices.
constraint: Material compatibility and structural design to achieve efficient plasmonic excitation without degrading quantum well performance.
mechanism: Field-enhanced emission via localized electromagnetic interaction: A conductive element with plasmonic properties interacts with a semiconductor structure containing quantum wells within a confined cavity. The interaction amplifies light emission through localized electromagnetic field coupling between the conductive and semiconductor materials.
mechanism_raw: Plasmonic enhancement: A plasmonic metal electrode excites surface plasmons in a quantum well structure within a nano-cavity, amplifying light emission through localized electromagnetic field interactions between the metal and semiconductor materials.

abstract: PURPOSE: An object of the present invention is to provide a method for producing a sugar crystal-containing liquid with good reproducibility, wherein crystallization is enhanced, it is unnecessary to add seed crystals which may affect the number of grains and a size of the crystals, and graining conditions are stable.CONSTITUTION: The present invention is a method for producing a sugar crystal-containing liquid, wherein the method comprises steps of preparing a liquid supersaturated with sugar; and applying a shearing force to the liquid, characterized in that the step of applying the shearing force comprises exerting a pressure higher than atmospheric pressure on the liquid to make the liquid pass through a narrow space.
problem: Producing sugar crystals with controlled nucleation and stable graining conditions without relying on seed crystals.
constraint: Controlling pressure and shear intensity to achieve uniform crystal size and prevent over-nucleation or structural damage.
mechanism: Mechanically induced nucleation via shear stress: A supersaturated material is forced through a constricted pathway under high pressure, generating shear forces that mechanically initiate crystal formation without requiring pre-existing nucleation sites.
mechanism_raw: Shear-induced nucleation: Applying high pressure to force a supersaturated liquid through a narrow space generates shear forces that mechanically induce crystal nucleation, bypassing the need for seed crystals.

abstract: A trigger module is particularly suited for use with firearms having an upper receiver and a lower receiver which are connected in an operable condition and may be separated to expose a trigger mechanism area in the lower receiver. The trigger module includes a module housing including a first side wall spaced apart from a second side wall. An automatic sear mount is included on the module housing and an automatic sear is pivotally secured to the module housing on the automatic sear mount. An automatic sear biasing element is also mounted on the module housing. One or more trigger mechanism mounts are also included on the module housing and a trigger mechanism is secured to the module housing on the one or more trigger mechanism mounts.
reason: The patent describes a modular trigger mechanism housing with specific mechanical components (sear, trigger mounts) but does not articulate a causal functional relationship or principle that creates a useful effect beyond the specific mechanical design. It is a product feature rather than a transferable mechanism.

abstract: For a new road set in a region where an existing road is not present in map data, a road associated information setting unit 13 determines and sets road associated information to be applied to a road link of a new road on the basis of movement history data relating to a plurality of moving bodies stored in a movement history storage unit 14. Accordingly, the road associated information on the new road is automatically set on the basis of the movement history data relating to the plurality of moving bodies, and hence a worker is no longer required to execute on-site investigation or manually generate road associated information.
problem: Automatically determining road-associated information (e.g., traffic rules, road type) for new roads not present in existing map data, eliminating manual on-site investigation.
constraint: Ensuring the movement data is sufficiently representative and accurate to avoid incorrect attribute assignments for new roads.
mechanism: Statistical inference from collective movement patterns: Movement data from multiple mobile entities is aggregated and analyzed to derive probabilistic attributes of uncharted pathways. These inferred attributes are then automatically assigned to update a digital representation of the pathways.
mechanism_raw: Data-driven inference: Movement history data from multiple moving bodies (vehicles, pedestrians) is analyzed to statistically infer road attributes (e.g., speed limits, traffic patterns) for new road links, which are then automatically assigned to the map data.

abstract: Method and system for the automatic monitoring of the process for the industrial cutting up and deboning of slaughtered animal bodies with respect to leaving the smallest fraction as possible of meat remaining behind on the bones extracted in the cutting process. For this purpose, images of segments that are detached during the cutting up of large pieces of the slaughtered animal body are recorded by an image recording device on at least one conveyor belt serving for transporting them away. Based on their different colors, images of these segments are differentiated from the conveyor belt, and bone, fat, and meat remaining on the bone of the images within the segments are also differentiated. By determining a quotient between a geometric quantity of the portions identified as meat for one or a plurality of segments and a geometric quantity of the same type determined overall for the same segment or the same segments, the fraction of meat in the separated segments is then determined. Finally, the result is visualized, for example, directly on a display, or/and is further processed for creating reports or for the output of warning signals.
problem: Ensuring minimal meat remains on bones during industrial deboning while maintaining process efficiency.
constraint: Balancing real-time image processing speed with accuracy to avoid disrupting high-throughput industrial operations.
mechanism: Using visual analysis to distinguish material types based on color and shape characteristics, then computing a ratio of quantities across segmented regions to quantify retention rates, enabling real-time feedback or reporting.
mechanism_raw: Image-based differentiation of materials (meat, fat, bone) using color and geometric analysis, followed by calculating a quotient between meat quantities in segments to quantify retention rates, enabling real-time feedback or reporting.

abstract: A method for operating a direct drive wind turbine including determining a temperature difference between at least two components of a bearing, comparing the temperature information with an upper threshold temperature difference between the at least two components of the bearing, limiting rotational speed of a rotor and/or an at least one rotatably supported wind turbine component coupled to the rotor to a value unlike zero yet, below a wind turbine specific nominal rotational speed of the rotor and/or below the wind turbine specific nominal rotational speed of the at least one rotatably supported wind turbine component coupled to the rotor and/or limiting electric power output of the generator to a value unlike zero yet, below a wind turbine specific nominal electric power output of the generator, if the temperature difference between the at least two components of the bearing increases above the upper threshold temperature difference, is provided.
problem: Preventing bearing damage in direct drive wind turbines caused by excessive temperature differentials between components.
constraint: Maintaining operational efficiency while avoiding damage, requiring precise threshold calibration to avoid unnecessary power/speed reductions.
mechanism: Monitoring thermal differentials between components and dynamically adjusting operational parameters (e.g., speed or power) when predefined thresholds are exceeded, forming a feedback loop to mitigate thermal stress.
mechanism_raw: Monitoring temperature differences between bearing components and dynamically limiting rotor speed or generator power output when thresholds are exceeded, creating a feedback loop to reduce thermal stress.

abstract: A communication policy server may receive channel availability information indicative of a plurality of communication channels detected by a communication manager of a vehicle, each of the plurality of communication channels configured to provide messages to a target recipient associated with the vehicle. The communication policy server may recommend one of the plurality of detected communication channels as optimal based on factors such as preferences of the target recipient and preferences of the message source, the timing of the messages and the content of the messages.
problem: Optimizing communication channel selection in vehicles based on conflicting preferences and dynamic conditions.
constraint: Balancing competing preferences and timing requirements without introducing latency or bias toward specific criteria.
mechanism: Evaluating multiple conflicting factors (e.g., preferences, timing, content) to select an optimal communication pathway, using multi-criteria decision-making to balance trade-offs without introducing latency or bias.
mechanism_raw: Evaluating multiple factors (recipient/source preferences, message timing, content) to recommend an optimal communication channel, using multi-criteria decision-making to balance trade-offs.

abstract: In a spark ignition engine, a thermal insulation thin layer is formed over a wall surface, facing an inside of a combustion chamber, of a base material forming the combustion chamber, and for a thermal conductivity λ [W/(m·K)], a thermal diffusivity κ [mm2/s], and a thickness L [μm] of the thermal insulation thin layer, L≧16.7×λ and L≦207.4×(κ)0.5 are satisfied. With such a configuration, a heat loss Q_total escaping from gas in a cylinder to the wall of the combustion chamber over all strokes can be reduced, and the thermal efficiency can be improved without inducing degradation of knocking due to an increase in an amount of heating Q_intake of the gas in the cylinder during an intake stroke.
problem: Improving thermal efficiency in spark ignition engines without increasing knocking risk.
constraint: Balancing heat retention for efficiency against the risk of knocking, requiring precise material property thresholds.
mechanism: Applying a thermal barrier with defined material properties (conductivity, diffusivity, thickness) to reduce heat loss while controlling intake gas heating, optimizing energy retention within safe operational limits.
mechanism_raw: Applying a thermal insulation layer with specific conductivity, diffusivity, and thickness constraints to reduce heat loss while controlling intake gas heating, thereby optimizing energy retention.

abstract: Techniques of magnetic field distribution are described herein. The techniques may include forming a wireless charging component including a driving coil to receive a driven current generating a magnetic field. An outer turn of a parasitic coil may be formed, wherein the outer turn is adjacent to the driving coil. An inner turn of the parasitic coil may be formed, wherein an inductive coupling between the driving coil and the parasitic coil generates a redistribution of a portion of the magnetic field at the inner turn.
problem: Controlling magnetic field distribution in wireless charging systems to improve efficiency and coupling.
constraint: Maintaining coupling efficiency while managing field redistribution to avoid losses or interference.
mechanism: Using auxiliary coils positioned relative to a primary coil to induce inductive coupling that redistributes magnetic fields, shaping the field profile to enhance energy transfer efficiency.
mechanism_raw: Using parasitic coils with outer and inner turns adjacent to a driving coil to induce inductive coupling that redistributes magnetic fields, shaping the field profile for better energy transfer.

abstract: A composite closure including a panel and an outer portion defining a recess into which the panel is received. The composite closure may be coupled with a container. The panel deflects downward toward the container when the composite closure is sealed with the container and the interior of the container is under vacuum.
problem: Creating a closure that maintains a seal or indicates vacuum status when a container is sealed under vacuum pressure.
constraint: The panel must balance flexibility to deflect under vacuum with structural integrity to avoid permanent deformation or failure.
mechanism: A compliant surface element deflects in response to pressure differentials between a sealed environment and ambient conditions, mechanically linking the closure's operational state to the internal pressure of the container.
mechanism_raw: A flexible panel deflects downward toward the container in response to vacuum-induced pressure differentials, mechanically coupling the closure's state to the container's internal pressure.
residual_terms: ["compliant surface element", "pressure differentials", "sealed environment", "closure's operational state"]

abstract: The present invention provides methods and compositions for expression and production of recombinant antibodies in a host cell system, such as prokaryotic and eukaryotic expression systems. Particularly contemplated are recombinant systems for temporally separated expression of light chain and heavy chain of antibodies. The antibody products including antibody fragments can be used in various aspects of biological research, diagnosis and medical treatment.
problem: Efficiently producing functional antibodies by ensuring proper pairing of light and heavy chains during recombinant expression.
constraint: The timing and control of gene expression must align with cellular processes to avoid misfolded or non-functional antibody fragments.
mechanism: Temporally staggering the production of two molecular components in a biological system to prevent premature interaction and enable correct structural assembly of the final product.
mechanism_raw: Temporally separating the expression of antibody light and heavy chains in a host cell system to prevent premature interaction and enable correct assembly.

abstract: The inventive technology includes methods and apparatus for the generation and application of segregated catalytic additives for the pre-combustion treatment of carbonaceous fuel and/or feedstocks. The application of such segregated additives results in the reduction of environmentally harmful emissions during combustion as well as gasification processes. Specifically, pre-combustion treatment of carbonaceous materials with the inventive additives results in the reduction of NOx and/or mercury emissions by least 20% and 40% respectively.
problem: Reducing environmentally harmful emissions (e.g., NOx, mercury) during combustion or gasification of carbonaceous fuels.
constraint: Additives must remain segregated to avoid interference while ensuring uniform distribution for consistent emission reduction.
mechanism: Introducing segregated reactive agents during a pre-reaction phase to selectively alter chemical pathways and suppress formation of undesirable byproducts in a combustion process.
mechanism_raw: Applying segregated catalytic additives during pre-combustion treatment to selectively modify combustion chemistry and suppress harmful byproduct formation.

abstract: A bowl includes a body portion. The body portion is formed from a material comprising a bulk molding compound. The bulk molding compound includes a polyester resin, glass fiber and calcium carbonate. A method for forming a bowl includes providing a composition comprising a bulk molding compound, providing the composition in a cavity of a mold including a male die member and a female die member, and compressing the male die member and the female die member under heat to form a molded material. The bulk molding compound includes a polyester resin, glass fiber and calcium carbonate.
problem: Manufacturing a durable, cost-effective bowl with optimized material properties using compression molding.
constraint: The material composition and molding parameters (heat, pressure) must balance strength, cost, and process efficiency.
mechanism: Compressing a composite material formulation under controlled thermal and mechanical conditions within a shaped mold cavity to produce a reinforced structural component with optimized material distribution.
mechanism_raw: Using a bulk molding compound (polyester resin, glass fiber, calcium carbonate) compressed under heat in a dual-die mold to form a structurally reinforced composite product.
residual_terms: ["composite material formulation", "shaped mold cavity", "reinforced structural component"]

abstract: The present invention includes a first injection tube for supplying a colloidal medium, a storage part connected to the first injection tube for receiving the colloidal medium through the first injection tube, a second injection tube connected to the storage part for supplying a colloid, a discharge tube connected to both the storage part and the second injection tube for discharging the colloidal medium coming from the storage part and the colloid coming from the second injection tube, and a free surface inversion part for inverting the free surface of the liquid in the second injection tube so as to mix the colloidal medium and the colloid in the discharge tube.
problem: Mixing a colloidal medium and a colloid in a discharge tube without external agitation.
constraint: The inversion mechanism must maintain flow continuity and prevent clogging while ensuring thorough mixing of the two substances.
mechanism: Reversing the orientation of a fluid interface within a secondary flow channel to generate disruptive flow patterns that promote homogenization of two substances in a primary discharge pathway.
mechanism_raw: Inverting the free surface of liquid in a second injection tube via a dedicated inversion part to induce turbulent flow and mixing in the discharge tube.
residual_terms: ["fluid interface", "secondary flow channel", "disruptive flow patterns", "primary discharge pathway"]

abstract: A refrigerator unit and/or freezer unit is disclosed having at least one carcass in which a cooled inner space is arranged and having at least one closure element by which the cooled inner space can be closed. The carcass has one or more contact elements at the carcass side and the closure element has one or more contact elements at the closure element side, wherein at least one switch is provided which allows a current flow through the contact elements in the closed state and prevents a current flow through the contact elements in the open state, wherein the switch is switched from its open state into its closed state upon reaching of a specific closing angle, and the switch is switched into the closed state as soon as or after the contact elements at the closure element side are in contact with the contact elements at the carcass side.
problem: Detecting when a closure element (door/lid) is properly closed so that an electrical function (current flow) is enabled only in the closed state.
constraint: The switch must trigger reliably at the correct closing angle and only after contact elements are engaged, balancing mechanical tolerance (to avoid false triggering) with electrical reliability (to ensure current flows only when fully closed).
mechanism: A mechanical state sensor is mechanically coupled to the closure's motion such that when the closure reaches a threshold angular position and opposing contact elements engage, the sensor transitions from a non-conductive to conductive state, enabling current flow only when both positional and contact conditions are satisfied.
